description_clean: About the teamMasan's centralized data platform powers analytics and machine learning across Vietnam's largest consumer-retail ecosystem (WinCommerce, WinX loyalty, Masan Consumer, Phuc Long and more). The data platform engineering team builds the layer that turns raw source data into contracted, monitored, reusable data products on Azure Databricks. We are looking for a Data Engineer with 1–2+ years of experience to help build an agentic data platform: one that automates the process of building data products at scale, from ingestion and modeling to monitoring and ML forecasting. You will build the agentic workflows and data products that run on this platform, work alongside senior engineers who own its shared components, and use AI coding agents in your daily work. Our success is measured by how little of our code we write by hand. What you will do Model and keep data trustworthy• Build dimensional models (grain, facts, dimensions, slowly changing dimensions) following theteam's dimensional-modeling procedure, starting with finance• Build feature stores, feature engineering for ML models, operate BI reporting products acrossbusiness unit• Add quality rules and SLAs to contracts with producer and consumer teams, and run the contract monitors• Investigate monitor findings, backfill, and document confirmed insights in the business-unit knowledge base• Define each KPI once in the metrics store, so dashboards, forecasts and AI agents read the same numberBuild and operate the agentic data platformThe platform turns a data product spec into running pipelines. AI agents draft the ingestion, models, contracts and tests from the spec, deploy them as code on Databricks, and monitor them in production. Engineers review every step.• Take a data product from spec to deployed jobs and schemas with the platform's agents andCLI, dev before prod• Review, test and correct what the agents generate before it merges, and report gaps in the agent skills• Operate platform runs: watch deployments and agent outputs, triage failures, and keep CI green• Maintance cost within the allocated budget, optimize pipeline and query performance, servicesreliability Must-have• 1–2+ years in data engineering; personal projects count• Spark hands-on, on-premise or on Databricks: DataFrame API, Spark SQL, partitions and joins, reading and writing Parquet, Delta or Iceberg• Strong foundation in data engineering: batch versus incremental loads, idempotent jobs, schema evolution, data quality checks• Strong foundation in database systems: SQL, indexes and partitioning, transactions, reading a query plan, normalized versus dimensional schemas• Agentic automation workflow capability: has built or run a workflow with an AI coding agent(Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent) or an agent framework, and can review and test what it produces• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills: breaks down unclear problems, questions assumptions, and checks results against the data Priority given to candidates with• SAP ECC or S/4HANA ingestion experience• Data migration experience: moving tables or pipelines from one platform to another with reconciliation of the result Nice to have• Databricks specifics: Unity Catalog, Jobs, Azure ADLS Gen2• Open Data Product Specification (ODPS) or Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS)• Infrastructure as code for Databricks: Pulumi, Terraform or Asset Bundles, deployed throughCI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions• Streaming pipelines and online feature serving (a big advantage): building real-time pipelines with Structured Streaming, Auto Loader, Kafka or Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, and serving fresh features to ML models at low latency• Personal-data handling: masking, tagging and access rules

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (NodeJS, ReactJS)
description_clean: Who We Are With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. What We Need We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer to join our Cloud Tool and Application Team within our Software Engineering organization. Your job will be to design, build, and maintain modern cloud-based applications, backend services, and user-facing platforms that support warehouse automation, digital twin, simulation, and robotics operations. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance software solutions that power Symbotic's next-generation automation systems. What We Do The Cloud Tool and Application Team is part of the Software Engineering organization, which is responsible for building the software platforms, tools, and services that power Symbotic's industry-leading warehouse automation solutions. Our team develops cloud-native applications, monitoring platforms, digital twin technologies, simulation systems, and operational tools that enable real-time visibility, diagnostics, fleet management, and business-critical engineering workflows across our robotics ecosystem. What You’ll Do Design, develop, and maintain modern fullstack web applications (React, Next.js), backend services (Node.js), APIs, and cloud-based tools for digital twin and simulation systems. Support real-time data visualization, monitoring dashboards, playback tools, diagnostic tools, and operational workflows for robotics and warehouse automation platforms. Implement highly secure and scalable data pipelines to ingest data from various sources, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of data used to update digital twin models. Manage and optimize cloud-based infrastructure to support digital twin simulations, including storage, computing resources, and network connectivity. Collaborate with UX/UI designers, product stakeholders, robotics engineers, cloud engineers, QA engineers, data engineers, and operational users to translate business and technical needs into practical application features. Work with cloud infrastructure, databases, messaging systems, and data pipelines to ensure applications are scalable, reliable, secure, and performant. Participate in application deployment, CI/CD, production support, troubleshooting, and system performance optimization. Support integration with simulation, digital twin, telemetry, diagnostics, fleet management, and AI-powered enterprise automation workflows where needed. Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, API specifications, deployment guides, and operational notes. Stay up to date with modern frontend, backend, cloud application, data visualization, security, and AI-assisted development technologies. Perform other related duties as reasonably assigned by the direct manager or the Employer. What You’ll Need 5+ years of professional experience in fullstack software development, with strong experience across both frontend and backend platforms. Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript, Node.js, and modern frontend frameworks such as React.js and Next.js. Solid experience designing and building scalable backend services, RESTful APIs, real-time services, and cloud-based applications. Experience building modern web applications with strong attention to usability, performance, maintainability, and reliability. Experience with frontend data visualization, dashboard development, or complex web-based user interfaces. Experience with web-based 3D rendering or visualization technologies such as WebGL, Three.js, or WebGPU is preferred. Experience with data processing pipelines, event-driven systems, real-time data streams, or high-volume telemetry data. Familiarity with cloud development and deployment on platforms such as Google Cloud Platform and/or Microsoft Azure. Experience working with databases and data platforms such as MongoDB, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar systems. Experience with messaging and streaming systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, ZeroMQ, NATS, or similar technologies. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, deployment automation, monitoring, logging, and modern DevOps practices. Plus{{:}} Experience with robotics, warehouse automation, digital twin platforms, simulation systems, IoT, telemetry systems, or operational data platforms. Plus{{:}} Experience supporting AI-powered, data-driven, or enterprise automation workflows. Plus{{:}} Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar tools. Good teamwork, communication, time management, ownership, and problem-solving skills. Working proficiency in verbal and written English, with the ability to communicate independently in an international environment and clearly present technical concepts, findings, risks, and recommendations to leadership stakeholders. Our Environment Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued. About Symbotic Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information.

description_clean: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview NET Developer Job Description We are looking for a skilled .NET Developer to build the Application Layer of a high-performance software solution running on Client/Edge devices (PC/Embedded). Core System Development (.NET 8+): Develop robust Console Applications / Background Services running on Windows and Linux using .NET 8+.Implement Multi-threading logic to handle simultaneous tasks (Data ingestion from Engine, UI updates, Logging) without freezing the application.Apply Asynchronous Programming (Async/Await) correctly to maximize system responsiveness.Ensure system stability: Implement "Watchdog" mechanisms, auto-recovery, and resource management (CPU/RAM). Native Integration (Interop) Use P/Invoke and Marshaling to call functions from existing Native Libraries (DLL/.so).Handle data conversion between Managed (.NET) and Unmanaged (C++) memory safely. UI Communication Implement Real-time communication channels to push data to the Frontend UI.Work with SignalR (WebSockets), TCP/UDP Sockets, or IPC (Named Pipes/Unix Domain Sockets). Data Persistence (Experience Level) Implement local data storage using relational databases: SQLite.Use Entity Framework Core or Dapper to save logs and operational data (Deep database optimization is NOT required, just functional usage). Integration & Environment:Interop: Experience integrating C++ libraries (Native DLLs) into C# applications (P/Invoke).OS: Comfortable deploying and debugging .NET applications on both Windows and Linux. Database:Experience with SQLite: You should know how to perform basic CRUD operations using EF Core or SQL Client. Nice To Have Windows UI Development: Experience building Desktop UIs using C# (WPF, WinForms, or WinUI). title: Division Principal Game Programmer (Unreal Engine, AI)
description_clean: WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON What you will focus on This role exists because reactive execution is no longer enough. The OTT programming division needs a technical authority who can shift the team's positioning from "a team that delivers what it is asked to build" to "a technical partners that others actively seek out because of the value it brings to a game's success." That shift requires someone who can set a long-term technical vision, build scalable production ecosystems, and drive focused R&D including applied AI in game development, while simultaneously ensuring flawless deliveries across multiple live and co-development projects. What it means on a daily basis Monitor the technical health of multiple projects, working closely with technical leads to surface risks early, prevent bottlenecks, and keep deliveries on track. Define and enforce studio-wide coding standards, architectural patterns, and engineering workflows, and drive their adoption across programming teams. Lead high-impact R&D initiatives, with particular focus on AI applied to game development, and ensure successful integration of outcomes into production pipelines. Provide hands-on technical guidance and mentoring to programmers, conducting periodic competency assessments and building clear development paths. Act as the primary technical counterpart for co-development partner studios, aligning on architecture, tooling, style guides, and Unreal toolchain standardization across shared pipelines. Collaborate cross-functionally with Game Design, Art, and Production to improve how programming integrates with other disciplines and contributes to overall product quality. Strategic resource planning and project allocation in partnership with the Studio Technical Director. What success will look like Within your first year, you will have made a visible and assessable impact on at least one co-development project or on a strategic technical mission defined in alignment with the studio's long-term vision. That impact will be confirmed through calibration with multiple stakeholders across the organization, not through self-assessment alone. Who you would be working with Report to the Studio Technical Director. Operate accross a programming department of around 35 to 40 people, spanning multiple seniority levels and allocated to live service and co-development projects. Collaborate closely with Department Heads and Team Leads across Game Design, Art, and Production, as well as Studio Directors and the Studio Manager. Work directly with Technical Managers and Technical Directors from co-development partner studios. Your recruitment journey Screen Call with a RecruiterFirst Interview with the Studio Technical Director and Division Principal/ManagerSecond Interview with Studio Manager and HR Director Final interview with a Technical Director from a sister studio Where this role can take you If the opportunity arises and the qualifications are in place, this position is a direct pathway to the Studio Technical Director role. That outcome is not guaranteed, but it is a realistic evolution for the right person. WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED Proven hands-on expertise in game development across multiple genres and platforms, including mobile, PC, and console.High proficiency in Unreal Engine 5 and programming languages such as C++ and C#. Demonstrated ability to design and lead large-scale technical systems, covering areas such as 3D rendering, AI gameplay systems, online and network scalability, and cloud infrastructure. A track record of leading R&D initiatives from exploration through to production integration. Demonstrated leadership of multi-disciplinary programming teams, including identifying skill gaps, building development plans, and raising the collective output quality of a department rather than just individual projects. The ability to communicate technical direction clearly to senior leadership, partner studio counterparts, and non-technical collaborators, and to influence decisions at a strategic level while maintaining alignment across stakeholders. Practical experience deploying AI and LLM-based tools in a production context. WHO YOU ARE Think in systems and long-term consequences, not just immediate fixes. Proactive technical authority who anticipates what teams and partners will need before they ask. Invested in developing others: raising the technical floor of a department matters as much as personal output. Hold grounds in complex stakeholder environments, with clear, inclusive communication. Hands-on by choice on the most strategic and complex challenges, not only in meetings. Balances technical rigor with product thinking: treats quality, security, and compliance as conditions for sustainable creativity. Steady and focused when priorities shift or organizational context changes. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU A hybrid working model with 2 days working from home every week. A range of well-being events and policies to support employees physically, mentally, and emotionally. Various training packages, including internal training, training sponsorship, and e-learning platforms (iLearn, Udemy, O'Reilly,...). Opportunities to collaborate and train with Gameloft worldwide experts and develop yourself. An attractive monthly salary alongside Tet and other performance bonuses. Minimum 12 days of paid annual leave, plus 5 days of paid sick leave, Christmas leave, Birthday leave, CSR leave,... 100% coverage of mandatory insurance plus private healthcare insurance. A monthly allowance to support lunch meals and working-from-home electricity and Internet bills. Relocation supprt for international candidates joining from overseas. Life at Gameloft A collaborative workplace environment, with over 15+ nationalities, where hundreds of world-renowned game titles were born. An open-space office, a canteen, a billiard table, a ping-pong table, and a foosball table. A gaming room equipped with mutiple devices (PS, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, arcade machine,...). A capable and encouraging team of professionals focused on creating compelling video games. A global company where you can meet great people around the world. A fun place to work in the heart of the city. HOW TO PROCEED Ready to level up your career? Apply now and help us create the next great game! Please note: To ensure a fair and compliant recruitment process under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), please submit your application through the official job posting, preferably via Gameloft website, Gameloft or Gameloft Vietnam LinkedIn pages, or SmartRecruiters. Applications sent via email or LinkedIn messages will not be considered. Due to the high volume of applications, only candidates whose profiles most closely match the role needs will be contacted by our recruiters. We sincerely appreciate your understanding and interest. What's more? Want to know more? Visit our websites: Saigon Studio websiteLinkedIn pageFacebook page Check out some projects at Saigon Studio: Dungeons & Dragons®Asphalt 8 - Coin Rush TrailerAsphalt Legends Unite - Launch TrailerApplaydu Season 6Bluey's Happy Snaps

description_clean: Software development is undergoing a massive shift, and we are evolving alongside it. At clearer.io, our goal is to empower online retailers to excel across search, discovery, and customer experience. Achieving this requires our technology foundation to continuously adapt. Artificial intelligence is no longer just a coding assistant; it is fundamentally transforming how digital products are built, deployed, and maintained. We actively integrate autonomous workflows, modern infrastructure, and fresh perspectives on modern development environments. Operating in parallel with fast-moving platforms like Shopify, keeping pace with innovation is essential to our daily operations. Because of this, we are looking forward rather than staying stuck in past practices. We seek forward-thinking engineers who thrive on rapid technological evolution and view continuous change as an opportunity to innovate rather than a challenge to manage. your impact Behind every seamless store load, targeted product discovery, and flawless feature deployment lies robust infrastructure—and that is precisely where your role begins. Joining us as a DevOps Engineer I, you will design, maintain, and scale the AWS platform underpinning Clearer, Boost Commerce, REVIEWS.io, and Influence. You will take ownership of architectural design, automated deployments, and comprehensive monitoring, empowering product teams to release features swiftly and securely while maintaining fiscal efficiency. Beyond managing critical cloud infrastructure, you will mentor Associate DevOps Engineers and foster engineering best practices across our global ecosystem. What You'll Do Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud-based SaaS solutions in AWS. Automate deployment and operational processes using AWS CodePipelines and Terraform. Enhance monitoring, logging, and security measures using Datadog and AWS-native tools. Optimize workload performance and reliability in EKS/ECS. Work closely with development teams to ensure DevOps best practices. Troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues, improving system resilience. Provide mentorship to Associate DevOps Engineers. What You'll Bring Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent and 2-4 years of relevant experience is required. Alternatively, an equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Experience with e-commerce and with specific experience of Shopify a plus! Strong experience with AWS infrastructure (EC2, ECS, S3, CloudFront, RDS, Lambda, SQS, etc.). Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and containerization. Proficiency in Terraform and Amazon CDK for infrastructure automation. Expertise in CI/CD processes and version control with GitHub & AWS. Solid understanding of Agile SDLC and DevOps methodologies. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. Hands-on experience bringing AI into DevOps workflows - such as AI-assisted code review, incident triage or automated runbooks - and setting the guardrails (access control, human approval for production changes, secret handling) that keep it safe and reliable. life at clearer.io eCommerce is crowded, noisy and increasingly complex. At clearer.io, we're built for a different outcome: clarity you can act on. We connect to the stack a merchant already uses. Our AI agents enrich their catalogue, learn from their reviews and customers, and put that intelligence to work inside the tools they already own — so their products get found, trusted and chosen by shoppers and AI, without replatforming. We do this across our products: Clearer, Boost Commerce, REVIEWS.io and Influence, used by thousands of merchants worldwide. We're a global team with offices in Australia, the UK, Germany, Vietnam and the US, backed for the long term by PSG Equity and Silversmith Capital Partners. We care about doing the work properly: listening first, building second and shipping quickly where it matters. Results matter more than rhetoric. Experience applying AI in retail, consumer, e-commerce, supply chain, manufacturing or other operations-heavy environments.

title: MTE Software Engineer
description_clean: Description Invent the future with us Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing by developing SoCs and platform solutions focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable AI compute for cloud, edge, and physical applications. AI is showing up in essentially every part of the technology landscape, and we’re focused on delivering the performance, efficiency, and reliability those workloads require. Ampere is building compute silicon and platforms for AI applications spanning a broad range of industries. We focus on solving exciting challenges in areas such as robotics and automotive, among others, but the core of our work is enabling efficient AI at scale and across multiple application domains. About The Role You will join the Manufacturing Test Engineering (MTE) Software team as MTE Software engineer, responsible for building the sophisticated tooling that allows our systems to provide the highest quality service. You will design and implement world-class Continuous Integration and Deployment frameworks. You will treat our internal infrastructure as a product, developing high-performance internal tools, APIs, and utilities to automate complex operational logic. You will be in charge in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and build self-healing systems and automated remediation workflows that detect and fix issues before a human ever sees an alert. Your work will be key to enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of the process. The MTE Software Team at Ampere Computing is a group of dedicated professionals committed to delivering high-quality products while collaborating closely with manufacturing and engineering teams in a dynamic and engaging environment. What You’ll Achieve Architect and optimize CI/CD pipelines:Design, build, and continuously improve high-performance deployment pipelines that enable fast, reliable, and repeatable software delivery.Eliminate manual effort by codifying infrastructure, configuration, and operational processes. Manage globally distributed environments using version-controlled, reproducible, and immutable Infrastructure as Code (IaC).Drive automation and develop internal engineering tools/utilities:Building APIs, automation tools, dashboards, telemetry, distributed tracing, monitoring, automated alerting, and self-service capabilities that empower test development and production teams to manage infrastructure efficiently.Replicate complex customer environments to support comprehensive system integration, deployment validation, and stability testing.Ensure cybersecurity and compliance: Design and operate systems that meet or exceed applicable global security standards, policies, and compliance requirements.Production support: Support escalations and reliability improvements: Troubleshoot failures across distributed systems, perform in-depth root cause analyses, and implement permanent code- and system-level improvements to prevent recurrence.Mentor and support engineers: Share technical knowledge, mentor team members, and contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering practices.Embed DevOps practices: Partner with test development and production engineering teams to implement DevOps methodologies, processes, and tooling throughout the software delivery lifecycle.Support additional strategic initiatives: Contribute to other technical projects and initiatives assigned by the manager. About You Min 2 years of experience in system development, integration engineering, or QA automation. Solid experience in continuous integration/ continuous deployment (CI/CD) process and tools (e.g., Jenkins, Gitlab CI). Proficient in Linux, Python, Java and/or C++ programming skills. Experience with distributed systems, observability platforms, automated testing, and deployment orchestration. Experience with version control systems: GIT and SVN Practical Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) Practical knowledge in network protocols (including DHCP, FTP, SFTP), network concepts such as HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, VPN, firewalls and load balancers. Have strong analytical, data-analysis and problem-solving skills. Strong Agile and DevOps experience in complex integrated environments. Hands-on experience with development with Advantest V93000 (V93K) SmartTest8 ATE platform is a distinct advantage. Experience in developing simulators tools. Knowledge of emulator tools is a plus.Experience supporting an organization or project assessed against ISO 9001 requirements is a plus. Experience working on products or engineering processes aligned with ISO 26262, preferably in software development, system integration, automated testing, or release and deployment engineering is a plus. Good written and communication skill in English and Vietnamese. Willing to learn and research new technology or jump out of your comfort zone. Good teamwork with ability to work independently. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science/ Software Engineer/ Computer Engineering, or related field. What We’ll Offer At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. Benefits Highlights Include Premium healthcare, personal accident, and fully paid social insurance scheme as well as annual health check, so that you can feel secure in your health and financial future. Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance. Daily catered lunch, a variety of snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

It also introduces harder operational problems: distributed compute, constrained capacity, platform migration, and the separation of workloads by data sensitivity; The Data Orchestration team owns data ingestion, movement between environments, and modeling for downstream users. Work with source owners to handle schema changes and prevent missing or duplicate records from affecting downstream users;Turn raw data into useful models. Stakeholder Enablement & CollaborationPartner closely with Data engineer to provide feedback on upstream data ingestion contracts, event tracking schemas, and warehouse performance optimization.Empower Data Analysts, Product Owners, and Growth teams to self-serve trusted data through clean documentation, intuitive table design, and BI semantic layers (e.g., Metabase).Act as an advocate for data literacy, reproducibility, and modern analytics engineering practices across the company. We're people-centric and here to power good. Every day, we future-proof urban spaces, conserve natural resources, protect rainforests, and save lives. This is a world where innovation, technology, and deep expertise come together to take our company and customers from what's now to what's next. We make it happen through the power of acceleration. Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to bring a better tomorrow closer to today. Job Description About the Role We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data Science team within a complex engineering environment. Working closely with Data Scientists and engineering stakeholders, you will be responsible for translating analytical requirements into scalable, production-ready code using Databricks and modern data technologies. You will support the development of analytics solutions by extracting, transforming, and preparing data, building reusable datasets, and implementing analytical workflows. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on coding, problem solving, and working with large datasets, while contributing to real-world engineering and operational improvements. Key Responsibilities Data Engineering & Preparation Build and maintain data pipelines within Databricks. Extract, transform, and validate data from multiple sources. Develop reusable datasets and analytical tables for Data Science projects. Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across analytical workflows. Analytics Development Translate requirements from Data Scientists into efficient and maintainable code. Develop data processing solutions using PySpark, SQL, and Pandas. Support feature engineering activities for machine learning and advanced analytics projects. Investigate data anomalies and support root-cause analysis activities. Optimise data queries and processing logic for performance and scalability. Collaboration Work closely with Data Scientists to support model development and deployment. Collaborate with engineering stakeholders to understand operational data sources and business requirements. Contribute to code reviews and technical discussions. Document datasets, code, and analytical processes. Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to improve existing data pipelines and analytical processes. Promote coding standards and best practices. Stay up to date with developments in Databricks, Spark, and modern data platforms. Essential Requirements Experience developing analytical solutions using Databricks. Strong proficiency in PySpark. Strong SQL skills, including writing and optimising complex queries. Experience using Python and Pandas for data analysis and transformation. Familiar with Airflow, KafkaExperience with with Docker, Kubernetes is a plusExperience with other stream processing like Flink is a plusExperience working with large-scale datasets. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. Good communication and stakeholder engagement skills. Experience working in collaborative Agile teams. Desirable Requirements Experience within engineering, rail, transportation, manufacturing, industrial, or asset-intensive industries. Exposure to machine learning workflows and feature engineering. Experience with Delta Lake and Spark optimisation. Familiarity with Azure Data Platform technologies. Knowledge of Power BI or Grafana. Experience using Git/version control. About Us We're a global, team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can bring a better tomorrow closer to today, this is the place for you. Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth. We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work. How we look after you We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with. We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

description_clean: Overview About Our Partner Our Partner is a leading Australian data and technology company that provides businesses with access to unique data and innovative products. By using our platform, our customers can confidently manage their commercial relationships, improve productivity and reduce financial risk. As a commercial credit reporting bureau, we offer a complete suite of credit reporting products and data insights covering the entire customer lifecycle, from customer onboarding and credit decision automation to credit risk management and automated collections. About The Role We're looking for a hands-on Software Engineer (Frontend) to help shape the direction of our frontend architecture, tooling, and practices across multiple squads. Youʼll operate as a technical expert, collaborating with design to elevate the frontend craft at CreditorWatch. In this role, your influence will span a product group. You'll drive cross-cutting frontend initiatives, set coding standards, lead strategic discussions, and champion frontend quality across the board. This is an opportunity for someone who loves building robust, user-friendly web applications, has strong Angular and React experience, and wants to lead by doing. As a team, we are on a migration path from Angular to React and are exploring Module Federation to support a more modular architecture. Frontend craft mastery: Define and advocate for coding best practices, architecture guidelines, testing strategies, and maintainability principles across teams. AI-assisted workflows: Act as an AI champion by driving the adoption of AI-assisted development workflows, leveraging tools like GitHub Copilot and AI integrations within Figma and Storybook to accelerate delivery and improve code quality. Design collaboration: Work closely with designers to align implementation with design vision, bridge gaps between design and development, and plan frontend efforts. Storybook & UI consistency: Maintain and evolve our component libraries using tools like Storybook, ensuring reusability, accessibility, and design fidelity. Security champion: Advocate for security and privacy best practices across frontend applications, from secure handling of sensitive data to safe usage of third-party dependencies. Understand when and why a new technology is (or isn't) a good fit. Youʼve worked on large-scale frontend applications and know how to balance pragmatism with scalability. You have a deep understanding of frontend security principles (e.g. XSS, CSRF, CSP, CORS, authentication flows) and how to mitigate them. Youʼre comfortable navigating ambiguous requirements and creating clarity for others. You regularly lead by example through clean, simple, and extensible code. You proactively explore and implement AI-assisted workflows (e.g. using GitHub Copilot, Figma AI, or Storybook automation) to enhance productivity and frontend innovation. Youʼve built observable frontend systems — you know how to instrument code for metrics that matter, and how to use them to debug and optimise experiences. Youʼre a strategic thinker who can align frontend architecture with broader business and design goals. You proactively improve systems, not just code – advocating for better testing, observability, and deployment strategies. Nice to Haves: Familiarity with accessibility standards and performance best practices. Experience working in a product-led company or SaaS environment. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and observability tools (e.g. Datadog). Understanding of backend systems and APIs to help design more efficient frontend– backend contracts Due to the large number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Models need to ship into production voice systems with real latency and reliability requirementsThis is not a data annotation role. description_clean: Overview About Our Partner Our Partner is a leading Australian data and technology company that provides businesses with access to unique data and innovative products. By using our platform, our customers can confidently manage their commercial relationships, improve productivity and reduce financial risk. As a commercial credit reporting bureau, we offer a complete suite of credit reporting products and data insights covering the entire customer lifecycle, from customer onboarding and credit decision automation to credit risk management and automated collections. We're looking for a hands-on Backend Engineer to build towards an orchestration layer that coordinates how customer, product, billing and access data sync across our platforms. You’ll build the integrations and automation that make onboarding scalable, reliable and observable. About The Role We're looking for a hands-on Senior Backend Engineer to help shape the direction of our backend architecture, microservices, and practices across multiple squads. You'll operate as a senior technical expert, collaborating with frontend teams and engineering to elevate the backend craft at CreditorWatch. In this role your influence will span a product group. You'll drive cross-cutting backend initiatives, set coding standards, lead strategic discussions, and champion backend quality across the board. This is an opportunity for someone who loves building robust, scalable backend systems, has strong PHP (Symfony) experience, and wants to lead by doing. Responsibilities Hands-on development: Write, review, and maintain high-quality, scalable and secure backend code primarily in PHP using Symfony frameworks. Backend architecture mastery: Define and advocate for coding best practices, microservices architecture guidelines, API design principles, testing strategies, and maintainability principles across teams. Microservices development: Design, build, and maintain microservices that are resilient, observable, and performant. Champion service-oriented architecture principles and distributed system best practices. Database expertise: Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data models across various database technologies. Ensure data integrity, performance, and scalability. AWS cloud infrastructure: Leverage AWS services to build scalable, cost-effective solutions. Work with services like EC2, RDS, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and other relevant AWS offerings. API design & integration: Create and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party services. Ensure APIs are well-documented, versioned, and follow industry standards. Security champion: Advocate security and privacy best practices across backend applications, from secure API endpoints to safe handling of sensitive data and proper authentication/authorization mechanisms. Observability & monitoring: Implement comprehensive logging, monitoring, and alerting using analytics tools. Build observable systems that provide insights into performance, errors, and business metrics. Agile methodology: Work effectively in sprint-based development cycles. Participate in sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and deliver features within sprint commitments. Tech mentorship: Guide engineers through informal mentoring, code reviews, and pairing in writing secure, maintainable and well-tested backend codebase. Elevate engineering thinking through high-quality feedback and modelling best practices. Department-wide engagement: Present technical decisions, demos, or initiatives to the broader engineering department and advocate for backend improvements company-wide. Proactive improvement: Identify and drive improvements to tooling, architecture, and developer experience before being asked. Polyglot mindset: Comfortably pick up and evaluate new tools, libraries, or frameworks where appropriate. Understand when and why a new technology is (or isn't) a good fit. Qualifications Core Technical Skills: You're a highly experienced backend engineer with expertise in PHP, specifically Symfony framework. Strong experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems design. Extensive working knowledge of databases (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL databases). Proven experience with AWS cloud services and infrastructure as code. Solid understanding of RESTful API design principles and best practices. Good English communication skills (both verbal & written), especially in the global software development environment. Quality & Security Focus: You care deeply about shipping high-quality, robust, and secure backend systems. You have a deep understanding of backend security principles (authentication, authorization, data encryption, secure coding practices) and how to implement them. You've worked on large-scale backend applications and know how to balance pragmatism with scalability. Integration & Automation: Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment strategies. Familiarity with analytics and monitoring tools for system observability such as DataDog. Collaboration & Leadership: You're a strong communicator and can influence across squads and disciplines. You're comfortable navigating ambiguous requirements and creating clarity for others. You regularly lead by example through clean, simple, and extensible code. System Thinking: You've built observable backend systems — you know how to instrument code for metrics that matter, and how to use them to debug and optimize performance. You proactively improve systems, not just code – advocating for better testing, observability, and deployment strategies. You're a strategic thinker who can align backend architecture with broader business goals. Continuous Learning: You're constantly learning and exploring how emerging backend technologies might be applied to real business problems. Experience working in agile/sprint-based development environments. Nice to Haves: Experience with containerisation technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). Familiarity with message queuing systems (SQS). Knowledge of caching strategies and technologies (Redis, Memcached). Experience working in a product-led company or SaaS environment. Due to the large number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Security Engineer
description_clean: Location: Ho Chi Minh CityProduct: BShield — Mobile App Security Why this role mattersBShield protects the mobile apps of Vietnam's leading banks, financial institutions and tech companies against reverse engineering, tampering and fraud. As a Senior Security Engineer, you will research the newest attack techniques and build the native-level defenses that stop them, working deep in Android internals, C/C++ and the NDK. If you love breaking apps to learn how to make them unbreakable, we want to talk to you.What you'll do• Research emerging attacks (reverse engineering, tampering, Frida/Xposed hooking, debugging, emulation) and build PoC countermeasures.• Design and code native protection modules in C/C++ and Android NDK: anti-tamper, anti-hook, anti-debug, obfuscation and tamper detection.• Go deep into Android internals (Linux kernel, ART, linker, system calls, memory) to build high-performance RASP.• Measure and optimize BShield's impact on CPU, RAM, battery and compatibility across OS versions and devices.• Reproduce complex issues and lead root cause analysis of native crashes and system conflicts, in both PoC and production.• Test new releases, join pentests and code reviews, and write troubleshooting guides and technical documentation.What you'll bring• 3–5 years in mobile security, reverse engineering or native/systems programming on mobile, plus a degree in Information Security, IT, Computer Science or a related field.• Strong C/C++ and hands-on Android NDK experience; deep understanding of JNI, memory management, pointers, ELF and dynamic linking.• Deep knowledge of Android internals (ART/Dalvik, Zygote, bionic libc, system calls, Binder IPC, SELinux) and the app component lifecycle; comfortable reading and working with Java/Kotlin.• Expert static and dynamic analysis of Android apps using IDA Pro, Ghidra, JADX, Frida and ADB.• Solid command of OWASP MASTG/MASVS, and skill in analyzing Logcat, crash dumps and stack traces.• A methodical, self-driven problem-solver who keeps up with new attack and defense techniques, explains technical issues clearly to partners, and reads English technical papers and whitepapers with ease.Nice to have• Hands-on experience designing anti-debugging, anti-hooking, anti-tampering, obfuscation or integrity verification.• iOS internals and security (Mach-O, dyld, Sandbox, Code Signing, AMFI, memory protections) and iOS reverse engineering with LLDB or Frida.• Objective-C (runtime, method swizzling) or Swift.• Published security research, in-depth writeups or CVEs.What we offer• Work directly with Verichains leadership and some of Vietnam's top security experts.• Help take a "Make in Vietnam – Go Global" product to international markets, with partners in Singapore, Thailand, the UAE and beyond.• Competitive salary, 13th-month salary and 14th, 15th+ month bonuses.• 14–16 days of annual leave; social insurance on full salary, health insurance and lunch allowance.• Annual company trip and team building in an open, flexible, globally minded workplace.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer (Junior)
description_clean: WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON What you will focus on As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you’ll own the telemetry and reporting foundation that the studio relies on to make data-driven decisions. You’ll work at the intersection of raw event data, analytics, and business reporting - making sure our data is clean, consistent, and trustworthy. The key challenge is to build a scalable tracking architecture while maintaining high data quality and reliable dashboards across the studio. What it means on a daily basis Own and improve the telemetry structure by defining events, IDs, parameters, and tracking standards across features. Validate and monitor telemetry data in BigQuery, identifying and resolving data quality issues before they impact analysis. Write, review, and optimize SQL queries to ensure KPIs and business metrics are calculated accurately. Maintain and improve dashboards across Metabase and Looker, ensuring consistent reporting and resolving issues caused by data or schema changes. Automate data processing and integrate data from multiple sources using Python and/or Node.js. Who you would be working with Data & BI teams – working together to maintain data quality, reporting standards, and a unified analytics workflow. Game/Product teams – collaborating on telemetry requirements and tracking implementation across features. Technical teams – coordinating on data architecture, schemas, integrations, and technical changes that may impact reporting. Your recruitment journey Screening CallTest (48 hours)Interview WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED SQL skills with hands-on experience in Google BigQuery. High proficiency in Metabase and Looker, or comparable BI and visualization tools. Knowledge of database architecture and data modeling, including schema design, data warehousing, and normalization/denormalization. Proficiency in Python and/or Node.js for scripting, automation, and data processing. Experience collecting data from multiple sources and cleaning, transforming, and integrating it into a unified database. Strong understanding of data quality, telemetry/tracking, and dashboard governance. WHO YOU ARE Highly detail-oriented and genuinely care about data accuracy and consistency. Structured and systematic, with strong documentation habits. Proactive in identifying data issues and solving them before they impact stakeholders. Strong ownership mindset - you take responsibility for the quality and reliability of the systems you manage. A clear communicator who can collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical teams. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU A hybrid working model with 2 days working from home every week. A range of well-being events and policies to support employees physically, mentally, and emotionally. Various training packages, including internal training, training sponsorship, and e-learning platforms (iLearn, Udemy, O'Reilly,...). Opportunities to collaborate and train with Gameloft worldwide experts and develop yourself. An attractive monthly salary alongside Tet and other performance bonuses. Minimum 12 days of paid annual leave, plus 5 days of paid sick leave, Christmas leave, Birthday leave, CSR leave,... 100% coverage of mandatory insurance plus private healthcare insurance. A monthly allowance to support lunch meals and working-from-home electricity and Internet bills. Relocation supprt for international candidates joining from overseas. Life at Gameloft A collaborative workplace environment, with over 15+ nationalities, where hundreds of world-renowned game titles were born. An open-space office, a canteen, a billiard table, a ping-pong table, and a foosball table. A gaming room equipped with mutiple devices (PS, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, arcade machine,...). A capable and encouraging team of professionals focused on creating compelling video games. A global company where you can meet great people around the world. A fun place to work in the heart of the city. How to proceed Ready to level up your career? Apply now and help us create the next great game! We're passionate about empowering our team to work on projects that not only push boundaries but also make a tangible difference in the lives of millions. Are you ready to be part of something greater? The RoleWe’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our digital transformation team and help build scalable, data-driven solutions across the business. The role offers a unique growth path: you’ll start with a strong Data Analytics focus, then gradually take ownership of broader Data Engineering initiatives as our data platform evolves.In the short term, you’ll work on SQL analysis, reporting, dashboards, data modeling, and translating business needs into actionable insights. Over time, you’ll move deeper into building data pipelines, optimizing Spark workloads, automating workflows, and developing scalable data infrastructure. We welcome Data Engineers who enjoy getting close to the business and are excited to grow from analytics into deeper engineering ownership. Key ResponsibilitiesData Engineer - Career FocusDesign and Build Data Pipelines: Develop, scale, and maintain robust, large-scale data pipelines and architecture using Python and advanced SQL.Analytics Enablement: Partner directly with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate analytical requirements into reliable, query-ready datasets and data models.Data Orchestration & Processing: Implement and manage complex automated workflows using orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Nextflow) and optimize large-scale data processing using engines like Spark, Clickhouse, or Trino.Drive Engineering Maturity: Lead the gradual transition from an ad-hoc, "analytics-first" workflow to one with rigorous data engineering standards, including version control, CI/CD, automated testing, and data governance.Performance Optimization: Identify bottlenecks, troubleshoot system failures, and continuously tune query performance and pipeline efficiency across the data platform.Data Quality & Reliability: Establish robust monitoring, alerting, and validation frameworks to ensure high data integrity and proactively resolve data discrepancies. Must-have Skills & QualificationsExperience: 5+ years of proven experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or a related technical field.Core Technologies: Strong programming skills in Python and advanced SQL profiling/optimization (able to understand execution plan).Data Architecture: Solid background working with large-scale data, modern data platforms, and analytics workflows.Processing & Orchestration: Practical experience implementing data processing engines (Spark, ClickHouse, Trino) and building pipelines using orchestration tools (Airflow, Nextflow).Mindset & Culture: Comfortable navigating an "analytics-first" environment while actively taking ownership to build robust engineering practices over time.Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem-solving capabilities paired with clear cross-functional communication (able to translate technical concepts into actionable items)Nice-to-Have QualificationsExperience in technology, healthcare, biotechnology, science, AI, or data-related industries.Experience with SaaS products, dashboards, AI platforms, or data visualization.Experience with 3D tools such as Blender or Cinema 4D.Experience with interactive motion or tools such as Rive or Framer.Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools and new creative workflows.Basic sound design or audio editing skills. Lifelong SkillsInquisitive Mindset: Demonstrates a deep-rooted curiosity, constantly seeking to understand project details and underlying principles, indicative of a continuous learning approach.Clarity and Insight: Actively seeks clarity and understanding of project requirements to ensure accurate and effective implementation.Depth of Perception: Has talent for looking beyond initial requests, intuitively grasping and addressing the core needs and objectives underlying a project.Implementation Insight: Skilled in outlining and describing the phases of project implementation, breaking down complex tasks into manageable steps.Articulate Communication: Exhibits strong verbal and written communication skills, adept at tailoring messages effectively for different audiences, ensuring that it is not only clear but also contextually relevant and empathetic. Why Join DataXightThis isn’t just another job; it’s an opportunity to join a team that's earnest about making a global impact in human health. We provide room for growth, a dynamic and collaborative work environment, and the chance to make your mark in an industry ripe for innovation. Join our team and immerse yourself in a dynamic, supportive, and friendly workplace that fosters collaboration and personal growth.Opportunity to shape how complex ideas are communicated across products and clients.Direct collaboration with senior leaders and domain experts.Meaningful work at the intersection of data, science, and business. Benefits & PerksCompetitive compensation.Flexible time off, including floating holidays.Private health insurance & full social, health, and unemployment insurance in line with Vietnamese labor law.Professional development support.Company-provided lunches along with a selection of coffee, tea, and snacks.Other employee benefits as stipulated in Vietnamese labor law, reinforcing our commitment to your growth and well-being.If you’re someone who thrives on solving complex problems and actively wants to transform healthcare, apply to DataXight today. Send your resume, cover letter, and relevant work samples or GitHub profile to careers@dataxight.com. We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to our globally connected team!

title: EMBEDDED SW ENGINEER -RS2
description_clean: Location Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam FORVIA HELLA is a listed, international automotive supplier. Coming together with Faurecia in the FORVIA Group, we build the world's seventh largest supplier of automotive technologies. As a global market leader in high-growth areas, FORVIA employs 157,000 people worldwide. FORVIA HELLA therein stands for high-performance lighting technology and automotive electronics. At the same time, we cover a broad service and product portfolio for the spare parts and workshop business as well as for manufacturers of special vehicles with our Business Group Lifecycle Solutions. With around 37,500 employees at over 125 locations, the Company is active worldwide and generated adjusted sales of € 8.1 billion on a preliminary basis in the fiscal year 2023. YOUR TASKS In the business division Electronics, you will be working with the software development team for Autonomous Driving Department. ▪ Analyze system and software requirements; design software architecture; perform detailed software design, development, and testing of product-specific software for radar systems throughout the entire product development lifecycle; ▪ Work with SW-architecture, Hardware-Software interfaces, MCU/SoC/peripheral device datasheets & user manuals to develop, test and debug software in accordance with software requirement specifications and defined development process; ▪ Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to propose and implement solutions to improve the performance of system, including function implementation and system interface optimization; ▪ Perform Software and System Integration activities, work with CI/CD and DevOps systems to verify Software Quality, Utilize AI agents effectively to improve productivity and software quality in daily work; ▪ Complete software module test report and integration test report according to test result; ▪ Primarily responsible of software modules of HELLA ADAS product; ▪ Other job assigned by Department Manager. Your Qualifications ▪ Bachelor degree or above, with major in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Mechatronics; ▪ 2-5 years experience in Embedded Systems Development; ▪ Experience with Embedded development tools, especially Rhapsody, Helix-QAC, Poly-space, winIdea, DaVinci, DOORS, PTC, GitHub, GitLab and IDEs (e.g. Visual Studio Code) ▪ Experience with simulation and development tools, such as Vector CANoe, vFlash, bash scripting, etc; ▪ Proficiency in C/C++ and CAPL; ▪ Familiarity with 32-bit MCUs, Infineon TriCore MCUs, and the NXP SAF8xxx SoC family is a plus; ▪ AUTOSAR experience is preferred; ▪ Knowledge in Communication & Diagnostic protocols, including CAN, LIN, Ethernet and TCP/IP and UDS. ▪ Ability to effectively apply AI agents (e.g. Copilot, GitLab Duo…), automation, and innovative solutions in daily work to improve Software Quality. ▪ Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and Python programming language is a plus ▪ Strong teamwork and communication skills; ▪ Good English communication skills, both verbal and written. Even if you do not meet all our requirements, do not hesitate to apply to us, because the further development of our employees is very important to us and opens up a wide range of opportunities for you in our company. FORVIA HELLA stands for the variety of all employees. Inclusion and diversity are firmly anchored in our company culture. We are continuously looking for new team players and welcome applications from all interested parties, regardless of their ethical and social background, age, religion, gender, disability, sexual orientation or identity. Please send us your application via our career portal, stating your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date, with the reference number req19058. HELLA Vietnam Co., Ltd. Vong Nguyen

title: DevOps Engineer — Cloud Platform (Kubernetes)
description_clean: At OL Vietnam, we have worked alongside our parent company, Orange Logic LLC, to support some of the world’s largest enterprises with their digital asset management needs. Orange Logic provides a premier Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform that streamlines workflows, enhances collaboration, and ensures compliance across complex digital ecosystems, empowering any team working with digital content the ability to efficiently create, manage, and distribute their content at scale. WHAT DIFFERENTIATES ORANGE LOGICWe are trusted by global leaders to work with over 100 customers, including many of the world's most recognized brands.Our business is strong and resilient, even in the face of economic challenges. During the Covid economic downturn, we did not implement layoffs or reduce compensation. Instead, we continued to grow, consistently expanding our team and adding dozens of talented members to our R&D department each year.You’ll work with top engineers and team members who are passionate about building flexible, scalable, and streamlined systems that will define the future of business management. MISSIONEvery Orange Logic customer runs on cloud infrastructure our team operates: Kubernetes clusters across several clouds and regions. We’re bringing that estate onto one consistent platform, defined in code, deployed automatically and observable end to end. What you ship runs in production the next day, and your customers are our own engineering teams: you turn their requests into self-service products, not a ticket queue. What you’ll do:Run the runtime platform: Provision, upgrade and scale Kubernetes clusters across clouds and regions, entirely in code (e.g. Terraform).Ship changes safely: Maintain the pipelines and automated deployment flows that deliver platform and product changes (e.g. Azure Pipelines).Operate what you build: Take part in the on-call rotation, handle incidents, and fix the cause, not only the symptom.Make it observable: Build the metrics, logs, traces and alerts that tell teams what is wrong before customers notice.Remove toil: Automate repetitive operational work, and turn recurring requests into documented, self-service products.Secure by default: Least-privilege access, proper secrets handling, and security built into the pipelines and the platform.Work with your customers: Product teams, QA and architects. Understand what they need before you build it. PROFILE Must-have:At least 3 years in DevOps, infrastructure or SRE roles, including running production workloads.Kubernetes in production: deploying, operating and troubleshooting workloads.Infrastructure as code with Terraform or a similar tool.Deep hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred).Linux, and automation written as code in at least one language (e.g. Bash, Python, Go), with source control and code review.The ability to use AI tools as a pair operator for infrastructure debugging, scripting, CI/CD, configuration and automation work, while keeping human control over validation, security and production risk.Working English, written and spoken. Nice to have:CI/CD and automated deployment tooling (e.g. Azure Pipelines).Observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces).Experience with more than one cloud provider.Configuration management (e.g. Ansible).Incident response and postmortems. Work locations: Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City. BENEFITSAs a full-time employee, you are eligible for our benefits program:Attractive salary package and 100% Gross Salary in probation period.13th-month salary. Monthly performance bonus.18 days of annual leave (cashback allowed if not used) and plus 4 days for an overseas company trip.Multiple allowances (Lunch, Gym, Parking, Birthday/Tet/Wedding voucher...).Full social, health and unemployment insurance.Premium healthcare insurance for you and coverage for 1 extra family member.Monthly team-building activities (Bowling, Go-Kart, Candle Handmade workshop) and special celebrations on Autumn Festival, Halloween, Christmas, Tet, …Monthly happy lunch and Daily happy hours with free snacks, soft drinks, fruit, and coffee. Data Privacy Notice for Candidates in Vietnam:By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood OL Vietnam’s Privacy Policy. Any consent provided herein is explicit and voluntary.Based on your consent, OL Vietnam will process your personal data for recruitment for the position you apply for, including evaluating your candidacy, communicating with you, and, where applicable, verifying relevant information as part of the selection process. If you would like OL Vietnam to consider you for future suitable roles, we will request your separate, explicit consent and you may withdraw consent at any time as described in the Privacy Policy. For details on how we handle your information, please refer to our Privacy Policy on OLVN Website. https://www.ol-vietnam.vn/privacy-policy Please be aware:Orange Logic only communicates with candidates through official @orangelogic.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from a verified Orange Logic Talent Acquisition employee listed under “Meet the Hiring Team.” We do not conduct interviews via text message or request payment or equipment purchases at any stage of the hiring process.

title: Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer
description_clean: Titan Dealer Management Solutions Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer About Us As a global player in the SaaS automotive landscape, Titan Dealer Management Solutions (Titan DMS) boasts over 170 staff globally and SaaS representation across more than 26 markets. Titan is now recognised as one of the leading suppliers of technologically driven industry solutions to automotive dealers and manufacturers around the world. Since 2009, Titan's flagship product, the Titan Dealer Management System (Titan DMS), has been adopted by Franchised Automotive Dealerships covering over 45 different Automotive Brands throughout Australia, Asia, Pacific Region, Middle East, UK, Africa and Europe, and continues to extend its global reach and reputation as a leading international software provider. About The Role We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer (Junior level, 1–2 years of experience) to join our Business Intelligence team in Ho Chi Minh City. Reporting directly to the BI Platform Architect, you will play an essential role in supporting the quality, delivery, and continuous improvement of Titan's Business Intelligence and reporting solutions for our international dealership customers. In this role, you will start by exploring and thoroughly testing our existing BI solutions and data workflows to ensure accuracy and uncover areas for improvement. You will also actively use modern AI tools to develop and enhance Power BI reports and dashboards requested by customers, while communicating directly in English with international customers to answer reporting questions and gather requirements within your assigned scope. We believe in structured mentorship and progressive responsibility. You will receive hands-on training and step-by-step guidance from day one, an opportunity to work directly with international clients, and applying cutting edge AI Business Intelligence to our project streams. Above all technical skills, we value a strong work ethic, integrity, a collaborative spirit, and a genuine eagerness to learn. What You'll Do Solution Exploration, Quality Assurance & Data Validation Proactively explore and build a solid understanding of Titan's existing BI solutions, reporting systems, and underlying business data flows. Conduct thorough functional testing, data validation, and quality checks across BI solutions and reports after each development stage. Critically examine reports, calculations, and workflows with a keen eye for detail to spot software defects, data discrepancies, edge cases, or anything that appears illogical or inconsistent from a business or user perspective. Document findings clearly and work closely with the BI lead to verify fixes and continuously improve solution reliability and usability. AI-Assisted Power BI & Reporting Development Design, build, and maintain customer-facing Power BI reports and dashboards based on agreed business requirements. Actively leverage modern AI tools to accelerate day-to-day reporting development, including writing and optimising SQL queries, crafting DAX measures, modelling data, and building clean visual layouts. Carefully review, test, and reconcile all AI-generated queries, formulas, and report outputs against source data to ensure accuracy before delivery. Maintain and enhance existing Power BI reports as customer needs evolve. Customer Communication & Requirements Gathering Communicate directly and professionally in English (both written and verbal) with international customers and internal stakeholders within the scope of assigned tasks. Investigate and respond to customer queries regarding their reports, metrics, and underlying data. Participate in customer discussions to gather, clarify, and document reporting requirements, translating business requests into clear technical tasks and report designs. Continuous Learning & Team Collaboration Work closely alongside the BI lead, participating actively in mentorship sessions, reviews, and knowledge sharing to progressively take on greater technical responsibility. Document reporting logic, validation checklists, and operational workflows to keep team documentation clear and up to date. Required Experience 1–2 years of professional experience after graduation in software development, information systems, data analysis, BI/reporting, or technical QA/BA. Solid foundational knowledge of relational databases and SQL (ability to read, write, and understand SQL queries to inspect and verify data). Practical capability and enthusiasm for using modern AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to assist with technical problem-solving, query writing, data analysis, and report development. Good written and verbal English communication skills, with the confidence to communicate directly with international customers to answer questions and gather requirements within assigned work scope. Strong logical thinking, analytical skills, and a meticulous approach to testing and verifying work. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a closely related discipline. Preferred (Nice To Have — Training Provided) Prior hands-on experience working with Data, Data Warehousing, ETL processes, or Microsoft Power BI (Power Query, DAX, data modelling, dashboard design) is highly welcomed. Basic familiarity with ERP, DMS, accounting, or business management systems is an advantage. Note on Training: Candidates who have not yet worked extensively with Data Warehouses or Power BI are still strongly encouraged to apply if they have a solid software or information systems background and a strong drive to learn. Structured on-the-job training and 1-on-1 mentorship will be provided. Development Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam Share On Terms of servicePrivacyCookiesPowered by Rippling
