title: Senior Data Engineer
description_clean: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life. The Position OPSWAT's data platform ingests from more than forty business systems such as CRM, finance, HR, marketing, support, product telemetry, lands the raw output in a Delta lakehouse, refines it through bronze and silver, and publishes marts that downstream consuming applications read. Apache Airflow on AKS orchestrates it, dbt Core models it, and the warehouse is moving from Microsoft Fabric Warehouse to Azure Database for PostgreSQL while all of that stays running. You own that path end to end, not a link of it: a source nobody has ingested before, carried all the way to a table a business user can open in a dashboard, and everything in between that decides whether the number is right and arrives on time. The extraction that survives pagination, throttling and a schema that changed without telling anyone; the schedule that fires when the data lands rather than when the clock says; the silver table that refuses bad rows instead of passing them downstream; the mart whose columns are documented and whose keys are tested; the semantic-layer definition that makes it usable; and the freshness and the cost of the whole arrangement. Senior Data Engineering owns the modelling standards and the parity proof that a dbt mart matches the legacy procedure it replaces. You own the path those models sit on; the pipeline that feeds them and the serving layer that consumes them and you build marts to that standard rather than to your own. The seam is real and it is worked together: you bring the source contract, the schedule and the serving behaviour; they bring the layer rules and the value comparison. You will work in an AI-assisted engineering workflow, where agentic tooling carries the mechanical parts and your judgement stays on the design: what a source's contract is, where a pipeline should fail loudly, and what a dashboard can afford to query. What you will be doing Onboard sources end to end: authentication, pagination, rate limits, incremental watermarks, landing, bronze, silver with quality gates, warehouse sync as one DAG family per data source, not a bespoke script per table.Own orchestration: DAGs triggered on data arrival, idempotent re-runs, backfills that do not double-count, pod sizing that fits the work, and alerts that page a human only when a human is needed.Build the last mile: the marts and the semantic-layer definitions on top of them, so a metric in Zenlytic or a chart in Superset resolves to a column that means what its name says.Keep the lakehouse healthy: compaction, Z-ordering chosen from real query patterns, vacuum only inside retention, and schema evolution that does not break a consumer.Make performance a measured number: before and after on the pipeline you tuned, capacity spend on the warehouse, caching or pre-aggregation where a dashboard is paying for the same scan every morning.Set and defend freshness and completeness expectations per source; when one breaks, diagnose to root cause and write it down.Run the platform underneath: AKS workloads, Helm or Kustomize, Terraform, image builds and CI/CD, Key Vault and managed identity, least-privilege access to every store you touch.Review pull requests on pipelines and models, and keep runbooks and standards current enough that the next engineer does not need to ask you.Work with the Analytics Engineers and Product Analysts who own the business definitions your marts serve, so a definition change and a pipeline change land in the right order. What we need from you 5+ years in data engineering, with production ownership of pipelines other people depended on.Expert Python and SQL: you can read a query plan and say why it is slow.A dataframe engine at volume: Polars, duckDB, Spark and the judgement to know when not to pull the data into memory at all.Airflow in production (or Dagster/Prefect and the willingness to move); you have debugged a scheduler, not only written DAGs.Containers and Kubernetes: an image, a pod spec, a resource limit, and what happens when the limit is wrong.Lakehouse table formats: Delta or Iceberg with partitioning, compaction and schema evolution treated as operational concerns, not theory.Dimensional modelling judgement and hands-on dbt: you can state a grain, choose a key, and place logic in the right layer.One cloud in depth: Azure, AWS or GCP including storage, identity, secrets, and the networking that makes a private endpoint actually work.Infrastructure as code: Terraform, and Helm or Kustomize. You have shipped a change through a pipeline rather than by hand.Observability habits: metrics, logs, alerts, and an on-call triage you can describe step by step.API integration craft, pagination, throttling, retry with backoff, incremental state and the difference between a source that is down and a source that changed shape.Working fluency with a BI or semantic layer, enough to know why a model that is correct in SQL can still be unusable in a dashboard.Clear writing. The incident report and the runbook are part of the job, not paperwork around it. It would be great if you also have Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server including Citus / Elastic Cluster in your background.dbt at scale: Elementary, exposures, column-level lineage, CI-enforced builds.Cost engineering: capacity units, warehouse sizing, and a saving you can attribute to a change you made.A platform migration you helped carry warehouse engine, orchestrator, or both.Superset, Zenlytic, Power BI, or another tool where you owned the semantic model rather than only the chart.CDC or streaming: Fabric mirroring, Debezium, event-driven ingestion.Standards or tooling you authored that other engineers actually follow. title: Senior Developer, Material Portfolio, Trims
description_clean: ABOUT YOUR ROLE: The Senior Developer, Material Portfolio, Trims is responsible for creating and maintaining scalable trim platforms that support VF brands and product categories. Reporting to the Manager, Material Portfolio, Trims, this role translates brand and product needs into consolidated, reusable, and technically validated trim solutions. The role analyzes trim usage, identifies opportunities to reduce duplication and complexity, and develops core platforms that improve adoption, speed, consistency, cost efficiency, sustainability, and supply resilience across brands. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE: Trim Platform Creation & Development Create and develop scalable trim platforms across key categories such as zippers, buttons, snaps, labels, tapes, elastics, cords, hardware, and packaging-related trims. Translate common brand and product requirements into core trim constructions, specifications, color or finish options, and application guidelines that can be adopted across multiple products and brands. Develop platform solutions that balance brand relevance with repeatability, technical performance, cost efficiency, sustainability, speed, and supply resilience. Maintain a clear pipeline of new platforms and platform enhancements based on portfolio gaps, product needs, market trends, supplier capability, and innovation opportunities. Portfolio Analysis, Consolidation & Lifecycle Management Analyze trim usage, specifications, suppliers, cost, performance, and adoption data to identify duplicate, fragmented, low-usage, or overlapping materials. Recommend and execute consolidation opportunities by aligning similar trim requests to existing core materials or by creating common platforms that serve broader business needs. Support lifecycle management of core and seasonal trims, including adoption, performance review, rationalization, replacement, and phase-out. Platform Validation & Readiness Validate platform constructions, finishes, compatibility, durability, appearance, and end-use performance across intended product applications. Coordinate sampling, testing, risk assessment, trial adoption, and corrective actions with Product Development, Quality, Sustainability, suppliers, and brand material teams. Ensure approved platforms have complete specifications, testing records, application guidance, supplier information, and digital assets for reliable adoption and commercialization. Cross-Brand Adoption & Stakeholder Collaboration Partner with brand material teams, Design, Product Development, Material Sourcing, Quality, and Sustainability to identify shared needs and embed platform solutions into seasonal development. Present platform options, consolidation recommendations, technical trade-offs, and business benefits clearly to support timely material decisions. Work with suppliers and internal partners to resolve technical barriers and improve the usability, relevance, and adoption of core trim platforms. Digital Portfolio, Analytics & Continuous Improvement Maintain accurate trim metadata, specifications, images, supplier details, lifecycle status, and platform relationships in PLM and material library systems. Track platform adoption, trim proliferation, material utilization, consolidation progress, and portfolio gaps to support data-driven decisions. Continuously improve platform-development and portfolio-review processes to reduce redundant requests, increase core-material adoption, and simplify the overall trims portfolio. WHAT WE WILL BE LOOKING FOR IN YOU: Technical Expertise Strong knowledge of trim categories, constructions, finishes, manufacturing processes, performance characteristics, and product applications. Demonstrated capability in creating scalable material platforms, comparing specifications, identifying commonality, and converting multiple requirements into consolidated solutions. Working knowledge of material testing, quality, sustainability, compliance, costing, supplier capability, and lifecycle management. Leadership & Collaboration Proven ability to lead and develop small teams. Strong interpersonal and communication skills to influence cross-functional stakeholders. Ability to build trusted relationships across teams and suppliers. Analytical & Strategic Thinking Strong analytical capability to interpret material usage, specifications, adoption, supplier, cost, and performance data and turn findings into portfolio actions. Ability to manage multiple platform-development and consolidation projects, align stakeholders, and deliver against seasonal and longer-range priorities. Experience with PLM, ERP, or material library systems is a plus. R-20261103-0046

description_clean: LOGIX TECHNOLOGY is a distinguished software services company, specializing in the provision of professional software development services, fostering strong partnerships through the establishment of offshore development centers, offshore product development, and software testing with an infrastructure-oriented approach. We excel at simplifying and enhancing offshore outsourcing, not only by delivering innovative solutions to meet our clients’ exact requirements through high-performance teams but also by significantly contributing to our clients’ success by reducing time-to-market and improving quality. At LOGIX TECHNOLOGY, we are committed to delivering the highest level of professional excellence and making a significant impact in the software development sector. If you are a dedicated professional looking to join a dynamic team working with global leaders, we encourage you to explore the exciting opportunities that await you with us. Job Summary We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build reliable control-plane and infrastructure automation software.You will design and develop backend services, APIs, CLI tools, controllers, agents, and distributed workflows that integrate with Kubernetes and infrastructure platforms. This role combines strong software engineering with infrastructure, distributed systems, and automation. Job Description Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate Golang backend services, APIs, CLI tools, agents, and controllers.Build integrations with Kubernetes, networking, storage, identity, cloud/private-cloud, and automation platforms.Develop control-plane capabilities for provisioning, configuration, policy enforcement, resource lifecycle management, and infrastructure automation.Design robust REST/gRPC APIs with authentication, authorization, validation, versioning, auditability, and idempotency.Build event-driven and asynchronous workflows using queues, streams, schedulers, and workers.Design for retries, timeouts, concurrency, duplicate delivery, partial failures, eventual consistency, and safe recovery.Ensure backward compatibility and safe rollout/migration of APIs, schemas, resources, and long-running workflows.Improve reliability and performance through testing, profiling, observability, and production troubleshooting.Collaborate with product, infrastructure, security, and SRE teams on requirement analysis, system design and operational readiness.Contribute to technical design, code reviews, engineering standards, and mentoring.Own services throughout their lifecycle, from design and implementation to production operation and continuous improvement. description_clean: YOUR NEW ROLE This role is for CODE LEAP's client company - JTL-Software JTL-Software is one of Germany's leading providers of e-commerce and ERP solutions. More than 50,000 retailers rely on JTL every day to run their business. Our global development center in Vietnam is looking for talented people to build the next generation of these products. You'll work in an international team that pairs German software quality and Vietnamese speed to innovate. Tens of thousands of merchants run their business on JTL. Their data, every order, article and stock movement, is spread across thousands of local systems, where it works for no one. We are changing that. The Customer Data Platform brings merchant data into the cloud, securely and with permission, and turns it into answers merchants can act on. It is the foundation beneath our new BI product, our AI agent Juno and every data product JTL will build next. A first version already runs end to end. Now we are taking it from a handful of pilot merchants to a foundation built for thousands. We are a new, small and senior team with a clear mandate, a modern stack (Python, DuckDB, dbt, PostgreSQL, Dagster, Azure, Terraform) and an AI-native way of working: specs and decision records first, coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex doing much of the implementation, humans owning design, review and judgement. You build the services that make the platform trustworthy: how data gets in, who may run what, and how products get their answers, for exactly one merchant and never for another. You own these services end to end, from infrastructure and pipeline to code, tests and production behavior. Security is not a feature here; it is the product. We hire at Mid-Level or Senior and set the level with you, based on your experience. The team spans Germany and Vietnam: two senior engineering leaders in Germany and three engineers in Ho Chi Minh City. You will work directly with the German leads, with our internal data team and with the product teams that build on the platform. Working language is English; we work asynchronously by default and meet daily in a shared overlap window. YOUR EXCITING TASKS Design, build and run backend services and container jobs in Python on Azure, including their Terraform and CI/CD. Make tenant isolation provable: short-lived credentials, least-privilege identities, row-level security and the automated tests that keep them honest. Integrate identity (OIDC, Microsoft Entra ID) so every person, service and run acts under its own identity. Instrument what you build so that when something breaks, we learn which merchant, which step and why. Write short specs and decision records before building; ship through small, reviewed pull requests.Design and run agent workflows: decompose work for Claude Code and Codex, orchestrate parallel agents, let them triage issues and draft fixes, and review what comes back with a critical eye. YOUR PROFILE AND YOUR PERSONALITY 6+ years (Senior) building production software, with strong Python. Hands-on experience running services on Azure or a comparable cloud, and with Terraform and CI/CD. A solid grasp of authentication and authorisation (OAuth2 / OIDC, tokens, RBAC) and secure-by default design. Good SQL and PostgreSQL; you know what roles, permissions and row-level security are for.Tests are part of done for you, and you would rather raise a loud alarm than ship a quiet mistake.Hands-on, daily experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex, beyond autocomplete: you have built agent workflows, orchestrated agents on real tasks and know where they fail. Azure Container Apps, Azure Front Door / WAF, Zitadel or Keycloak. Building agent tooling: MCP servers, custom skills and hooks, agent evals, automated issue triage or AI-assisted SRE. E-commerce or ERP background. Because collaborating with the right people is the secret to our successful growth. We future-proof organizations - be part of it!

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description_clean: Engineering has changed. We're changing with it. At clearer.io, we build the software that helps eCommerce merchants win on search, discovery, and customer engagement. Building that well, in this market, means the engineering behind it can't stand still either. AI has moved past being a coding aid, it's reshaping how software actually gets built, from spec to delivery, and we're moving with it rather than waiting for the dust to settle: agentic workflows, new tooling, new ideas about what a software factory even looks like. We build on and around Shopify, a platform that changes just as fast, so staying current isn't a nice to have here, it's the job. That's why we're not hiring for where engineering was. We're hiring the next level of engineer, people who see this pace of change as the interesting part of the work, not something to survive until things settle down. Your Impact: As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build and run production AI/ML systems, from classic ML models to LLM and agent-based applications, that improve the user experience and business results. You will lead technical work on large AI systems, set a high bar for AI-native engineering practice, mentor engineers and work with stakeholders to define and deliver AI initiatives. What You'll Do Develop and maintain scalable ML pipelines on Databricks and AWS covering data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation and serving, with monitoring, drift detection and automated retraining. Build systems that combine models, tools and data into cohesive, agentic workflows capable of executing multi-step tasks. This includes designing system behaviors such as planning, tool use, structured outputs and failure handling. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in model training and inference through profiling, optimization, and architectural improvements, optimizing for latency and cost (e.g., TensorRT, quantization, batching). Set up evaluation frameworks for LLM and ML systems, including offline evals, online A/B tests and quality guardrails, and ensure model fairness, bias mitigation and responsible AI practices. Find and redesign engineering and business workflows using AI tools, and measure the impact. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate product requirements into production-ready systems, and continuously improve system performance through iteration and evaluation. Mentor engineers on ML practice and AI-assisted development. What You'll Bring 5+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on machine learning systems, model development, or ML infrastructureProven track record of deploying AI/ML solutions at scale in production. Experience in one or more specialized ML domains: search, recommendation systems, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision or generative AI. Experience leading and owning end-to-end delivery of AI/ML projects, including technical design, cross-functional collaboration, and operational readiness. Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing and refactoring. Familiarity with LLM-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL and data exploration, and speeding up engineering workflows. Has integrated AI tools to improve engineering efficiency and code quality, or to redesign workflows, with measurable impact such as time saved, defect reduction or throughput gains. Keeps building AI skills, for example prompt and context engineering or agent orchestration, and stays current with new AI technologies. Excellent communication and mentorship skills. Good English communication skills (written and verbal) Tech Stack: Languages: Python (primary) Data & ML platform: Databricks (Spark, MLflow, Unity Catalog), AWS (SageMaker, S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS) Vector search / RAG: Qdrant Inference optimisation: TensorRT Frameworks: PyTorch, Hugging Face; LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) and agent frameworks Nice to have: LLM observability and eval tooling (e.g. Datadog LLM Observability), Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD for ML life at clearer.io eCommerce is crowded, noisy and increasingly complex. At clearer.io, we're built for a different outcome: clarity you can act on. We connect to the stack a merchant already uses. Our AI agents enrich their catalogue, learn from their reviews and customers, and put that intelligence to work inside the tools they already own — so their products get found, trusted and chosen by shoppers and AI, without replatforming. We do this across our products: Clearer, Boost Commerce, REVIEWS.io and Influence, used by thousands of merchants worldwide. We're a global team with offices in Australia, the UK, Germany, Vietnam and the US, backed for the long term by PSG Equity and Silversmith Capital Partners. We care about doing the work properly: listening first, building second and shipping quickly where it matters. Results matter more than rhetoric. Once a year we'll fund a day with the local team VN 100% Remote Culture: Work from anywhere in Vietnam that brings you happiness. Performance-based Year-End Bonus: Recognizing and rewarding your individual contributions. Wellness Allowance: Support for classes promoting physical and mental health. Time Off: 20 days/year, in addition to Vietnam holidays. MacBook Provided. Collaborative Events: Offline meet-ups, monthly gatherings and year-end party. Continuous Learning: Technical and general workshops, online resources. Health and Wellness Benefits: Generali Health Care, annual check-up. International Exposure: Enhance expertise and English communication skills. a fair shot for everyone We're committed to a fair and inclusive hiring experience. title: AI Engineer
description_clean: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. The Position My OPSWAT Portal is OPSWAT's one stop hub for customers and partners. We provide a central place to manage licenses, access support, download products, track training, and navigate OPSWAT cloud services securely. It brings essential tools together in one place so customers and partners can get started quickly and stay productive. This role is for an engineer who would rather own the model than rely on someone else: you build and integrate AI/LLM features into our platform based on product and business requirements. You will be responsible for continuously improving the AI’s accuracy, latency, cost efficiency, security, and reliability. What You Will Be Doing: Develop and integrate RAG, AI agents, recommendation/search systems, and AI-powered automation workflows. Build and maintain data ingestion, embedding, retrieval, and evaluation pipelines. Collaborate with the Engineering Team (Developers & QA) to design, build, test, and deliver AI features. Collaborate with the DevOps Team to deploy, monitor, and optimize our self-hosted LLMs. Build and maintain evaluation gates for every LLM change and make it something the team trusts more than its own intuition. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. What We Need We are looking for a Simulation Engineer to join our Simulation Team within our Software Engineering organization. Your job will be to design, develop, optimize, and scale simulation systems that support the design, validation, testing, and deployment of large-scale robotic warehouse automation solutions. You will work closely with robotics, controls, perception, cloud, and product teams to build simulation capabilities that accelerate engineering innovation and improve system performance. What We Do The Simulation Team is part of the Software Engineering organization, which is responsible for building the software platforms and technologies that power Symbotic's warehouse automation solutions. Our team develops simulation systems, digital twin platforms, cloud applications, and visualization tools that help engineers, operators, and stakeholders better understand, validate, and optimize robotic automation workflows. What You’ll Do Design, develop, and maintain simulation systems, tools, and virtual environments that support the development, testing, qualification, and deployment of robotic warehouse automation systems. Develop faster-than-real-time, scalable, and optimized simulation environments to support engineering analysis, design validation, system testing, and operational planning. Build and improve simulation capabilities across multiple levels of fidelity, including component-level, robot-level, fleet-level, and system-level simulation. Evaluate existing simulation tools, identify performance, scalability, accuracy, and usability gaps, and drive improvements that enable faster and more cost-effective engineering workflows. Support simulation coverage for individual robots, perception, controls, routing, fleet coordination, warehouse operations, and system-wide automation scenarios. Collaborate with robotics, controls, perception, cloud, QA, and product teams to align simulation capabilities with product development, testing, deployment, and operational needs. Provide senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders with clear technical insights, trade-off analysis, risks, and recommendations to support long-term simulation and robotics roadmaps. Mentor other engineers, share technical knowledge, promote engineering best practices, and help the team deliver innovative and scalable simulation solutions. Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, simulation design notes, configuration guides, and operational usage instructions. Stay up to date with modern simulation technologies, robotics frameworks, digital twin platforms, physics engines, rendering engines, cloud-based simulation, and AI-assisted development tools. Perform other related duties as reasonably assigned by the direct manager or the Employer. What You’ll Need Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline. 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably with experience in simulation systems, robotics systems, optimization systems, or virtual environments. (Bonus point for C# and JS) Strong software engineering foundation, with the ability to design, implement, test, optimize, and maintain complex simulation software. Hands-on experience developing simulations, digital twins, virtual environments, or system modeling tools for real-world engineering applications. Plus{{:}} Experienced with faster-than-real-time and multi-fidelity modeling in simulation. Plus{{:}} Experience with cloud-based simulation, distributed simulation workloads, or scalable simulation infrastructure. Plus{{:}} Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar tools. Good teamwork, communication, time management, ownership, and problem-solving skills. Working proficiency in verbal and written English, with the ability to communicate independently in an international environment and clearly present technical concepts, findings, risks, and recommendations to leadership stakeholders. title: Data Engineering Lead (Production Bioinformatics & ML Platform)
description_clean: About Gene SolutionsGene Solutions is a pioneering genetic testing company, with teams around the world, dedicated to making next-generation genetic testing accessible. Our work spans Reproductive Health and Clinical Oncology, from multi-cancer early detection to circulating-tumor-DNA-based disease tracking. We are backed by a strong, publication-active R&D team with years of invested experience.The RoleWe are looking for a Lead Engineer to lead, technically, the team that builds and runs our commercial software platform: the production system that runs our R&D team's bioinformatic pipelines (mostly Nextflow) and machine-learning models at high volume, every day, for the clinical genetic tests our customers rely on. Your team makes these pipelines reliable, scalable, traceable and fast in production, and keeps them that way as the load grows.The platform sits between R&D and IT. You will not manage either team, yet much of your work depends on both, so the role needs strong architectural judgement and the people skills to move work forward through influence rather than authority.This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set the platform's technical direction and make its key technical decisions — designing it to absorb growing volumes, new tests and new models without being rebuilt — while doing a real share of the technical work yourself.What You Will DoSet the technical direction — define where the platform should be in two to three years and the roadmap to get there; make the architecture, technology and build-versus-buy decisions.Stay hands-on — write production code, prototype and benchmark design options, review infrastructure and pipeline code, and lead the investigation of the hardest production incidents.Design for heavy and growing load — workflow orchestration and scheduling, compute capacity, storage and movement of large sequencing files, and predictable turnaround times.Bring pipelines and models into production — packaging, containerisation, versioning, validation, release and rollback, so that new and updated tests ship quickly and safely.Keep the system running smoothly — monitoring, alerting, incident response and capacity planning; set and meet service levels for availability and turnaround time.Build in clinical-grade quality — every result reproducible and traceable to the exact pipeline, model, reference data and software version that produced it; patient data protected; audit and regulatory requirements supported.Lead the team technically — make and explain the key decisions, break the roadmap into deliverable work, guide engineers through design and code review, and set engineering standards, including that AI-generated code is reviewed and owned like any other.Work across R&D and IT — agree with R&D what a production-ready pipeline looks like; plan infrastructure, storage and security with IT; resolve competing priorities through clear proposals and data; and explain technical risks and trade-offs to management.Integrate with international partners — work with partner teams around the world to integrate our solutions with their platforms: agree interfaces and data exchange, deploy into partner environments, and troubleshoot jointly across organizations.What We're Looking ForSubstantial experience building and running production software systems — typically eight or more years — including several years as the technical lead of a team while staying hands-on.A proven track record as an architect of systems that handle heavy and growing load in production.Excellent people skills — delivering through teams you do not manage: negotiating priorities, resolving disagreements and building trust.Clear communication in fluent English, in writing and in person, with executives, scientists, engineers and international partners alike.Strategic thinking and sound judgement — seeing where the system must go and getting there in safe steps, in a setting where results inform patient care.A degree in computer science, software engineering, bioinformatics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.Core Technical SkillsHands-on experience with workflow orchestration and with Slurm and/or cloud infrastructure is required. Across the other areas we expect solid ability in most and real depth in several:Workflow orchestration — how orchestration works (task graphs, scheduling, resource requests, data staging, retries, caching) and hands-on use of at least one framework: Nextflow, Snakemake, WDL/Cromwell, Airflow, Argo or Temporal. Our pipelines are written in Nextflow; if it is new to you, be ready to learn it.Compute infrastructure — Slurm (or another HPC scheduler) and/or AWS, GCP or Azure, including running large batch workloads.Programming — Go, which parts of our platform are written in, and, Python, plus Bash and SQL. Strong engineers from another back-end language are welcome if ready to pick up Go quickly.Software architecture — distributed systems, APIs, queue- and event-driven processing, fault tolerance and horizontal scaling.Containers and Linux — Docker, Kubernetes, Linux administration, networking, storage (including object storage such as S3 or MinIO) and performance profiling.DevOps and reliability — Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and logging.Data and ML in production — relational databases and message brokers (e.g. PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Kafka); packaging, versioning and batch inference of models.Security — access control, secrets management, encryption and secure handling of patient data.Nice to HaveHands-on Nextflow — running pipelines in production, ideally writing and optimising them (DSL2, nf-core).Bioinformatics or NGS data — FASTQ/BAM/VCF and tools such as BWA, samtools or GATK.Both HPC and cloud, hybrid on-premise and cloud architectures, moving very large files over constrained networks, and infrastructure cost control.What We OfferReal ownership of the technical direction of a production system at the heart of the business.Meaningful work: the systems you build deliver results that improve patients' healthcare.Close collaboration with a strong, publication-active R&D team in an international company.A competitive compensation package, including private health insurance.Flexible working hours and a partial work-from-home option (upon approval).

description_clean: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life. The Position OPSWAT's data platform turns business-system data into governed, documented, tested tables that business teams can read without asking what a column means. It is built on dbt Core, layered source → staging → intermediate → mart, and the warehouse is moving from Microsoft Fabric Warehouse to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. You will learn the craft on the real thing: models that ship, with value parity proven before anything is cut over. This is the entry point to analytics engineering on this team, and it is a working role rather than an observation one. You will build models for the domains assigned to you and they will go into production. What differs from a more senior role is the supervision, not the bar: every change is reviewed before it lands, you have a named mentor, and you are paired with a Product Analyst on the business side: the two halves answer for the same number. By day 60 you are expected to be delivering a model with less correction than your first one, not to still be waiting for instructions. What You Will Be Doing Build staging, intermediate and mart dbt models for the domains assigned to you, following the team's layer standards: what belongs in each layer, where collation is normalised, one path in per source.Write tests that fail when the data breaks, not checks that pass whatever the data does.Run parity comparisons between a dbt model and the legacy procedure it replaces: execute the comparison, record the numbers, and learn what "proven" means before a consumer is repointed.Investigate the quality failures your tests surface, and trace them back to the source instead of patching the symptom in the model.Keep documentation and lineage current as models change, so the next reader does not have to ask what a column means.Work across both engines while the warehouse migrates, and notice when the same model behaves differently on each.Work in an AI-assisted engineering workflow. You set the task, review the output, and own what lands.Pair with a Product Analyst to learn what the business needs from a number, and why a definition is worth arguing about.Ask for review early, and act on it. What we need from you 0–2 years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a comparable role or a portfolio that shows the same work.Working SQL: joins, filters, aggregations, CTEs. Window functions are the next thing you learn, and you are already reading about them.Some Python for data work. A script you wrote, a notebook you finished, a pipeline you broke and then fixed.Git and pull-request basics, or the willingness to learn them in the first week.The habit of checking your own numbers before sharing them: reconciliation, sanity checks, and saying so when something does not add up.Curiosity about how the business actually works. You want to know why the data looks the way it does.Willingness to ask for help early. On this team that is the norm, not a weakness. It Would Be Great If You Also Have Exposure to dbt, or another transformation framework, from coursework or a project.A BI tool you have built in: Superset, Power BI, Looker, or similar.A data project you can talk about for ten minutes: what it was for, what you got wrong, and what you changed.Comfort in a terminal: Docker, a CLI, a cloud console.Azure basics: storage, identity, or a service you have actually used What success looks like in your first 60 days Your first models are merged, reviewed, and pass the layer-standards check. You learned the rules by applying them.A test you wrote catches something real, or would fail if the model broke.You have run a parity comparison end to end and can explain what "proven" means without reading the definition back.You can explain your domain's data in business terms, and why the definition matters.Your reviewer's comments are getting fewer and smaller: the next model needs less correction than the first. title: DevOps Engineer (Middle - Senior)
description_clean: About the roleBuild like a founder. Ship like Spartan.Our clients are startups in a race: an MVP in 30 days, real traffic the day after launch. We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to keep them fast, up, and cheap to run.We don’t act like vendors. We embed. Our teams sit inside startups backed by YC, Pear VC, BlingCap, a16z, and Techstars, working beside founders and engineers from Stanford, MIT, Yale, Google, Amazon, and Uber. Together we ship those MVPs and scale the systems behind them to millions of users and billions of requests.This isn’t a back-office ops seat three layers from the client. You’ll be in the founder’s Slack. Your infrastructure runs their launch. When their product survives its first traffic spike, that’s your work holding it up.70% of our portfolio is LLM-powered. That means real GPU workloads, real traffic spikes, and real cloud bills. You’ll design the infrastructure behind it. Cursor, Claude, and Codex are default tools here, and you’ll use them to automate the boring parts. Who Thrives at SpartanNot every environment fits everyone, so here’s an honest picture of the teammate we’re looking for.You’ll thrive here if:You do whatever it takes to win. Terraform today, debugging someone’s Node service tomorrow.You own an incident until it’s resolved, whether it started in your area or not.You treat cost like a feature. You can tell a founder why their bill dropped 40%.You automate the boring parts without being asked.Some weeks will stretch you. That’s the job. But you’ll never carry it alone. A critical incident or a high-stakes migration? You won’t be the only one on it. We push each other hard because we care how far each of us can go. We win together. We lose together. Nobody gets left behind.One last thing. We’re not filling seats. We’re looking for teammates for the battles ahead. If you read all this and something in you said yes, trust that feeling and apply. We respect people who back themselves. Every Spartan here started with that same yes. What You’ll DoDesign and run multi-cluster, multi-cloud Kubernetes environments across AWS EKS, GCP GKE, and Azure AKS: highly available, disaster-resilient, auto-scaling.Build GitOps-driven CI/CD pipelines with ArgoCD or FluxCD.Tune performance, reliability, and cost. Every dollar saved is margin for the startup we serve.Run AI infrastructure: GPU workloads, model serving, vector databases, and the inference bills that come with them.Automate ops with AI: runbooks, incident summaries, IaC generation with Cursor and Claude.Secure workloads: RBAC, Network Policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, vulnerability scanning.Work with dev teams on containerization and app modernization.Mentor engineers on Kubernetes and infrastructure practices.Turn what you build into reusable accelerators: CI/CD templates, starter kits, monitoring setups that cut project startup time across clients. Whom We’re Looking ForFluent English. You’ll talk directly with US startup founders.At least 3-6 years in DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure, with Kubernetes in production.Strong Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm, Ansible.Deep knowledge of Docker/OCI runtimes, Linux, networking, and troubleshooting.Hands-on with monitoring stacks: DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Jaeger.Solid grasp of Kubernetes internals.You use AI tools like a pro: you review what they write, catch their mistakes, and know when not to use them.A builder’s mindset. You don’t just run infra, you solve problems like an owner. Nice to HaveYou’ve run LLM serving in production: vLLM, GPU scheduling, or managed inference endpoints.Backend engineering experience.CKA, CKAD, or CKS certifications.Service mesh: Istio, Linkerd, Consul.Open-source contributions to Kubernetes or CNCF projects.Cloud cost optimization wins you can put numbers on. Tech We UseEvery project brings a different stack, so in a year here you’ll touch more of this list than most engineers do in five. Two rules hold everywhere: everything as code, no click-ops. And what we adopt is decided by our engineers through an internal Tech Radar, not handed down from a slide deck.Platform: Kubernetes (EKS · GKE · AKS) · DockerIaC & GitOps: Terraform · Helm · Ansible · ArgoCD · FluxCDCI/CD: GitHub Actions · JenkinsObservability: OpenTelemetry · Prometheus · Grafana · DataDog · ELK · JaegerAI infra: vLLM · GPU workloads · pgvector · QdrantCloud & edge: AWS · GCP · Azure · CloudflareAI tooling: Cursor · Claude · Codex Career GrowthWork directly with founders from YC, Stanford, MIT, Yale, Google, Amazon, Uber, and more.Exposure to AI infrastructure: LLM serving, vector databases, GPU workloads.Transparent career path and mentorship from engineers who’ve taken 3 companies to IPO.Every project feels like its own mini-startup. Why Spartan50+ MVPs launched, 3 IPOs, $100M+ raised by the startups we build with.95% engineer retention. People stay because the work is worth staying for.You build zero to one. Empty cloud account to production infrastructure in weeks. Most engineers get that chance once in a career. Here it’s the job.Your work is visible. The infrastructure you build this month carries a founder’s launch next month.No layers, no bureaucracy. You talk to the decision-maker directly, and decisions land in hours, not weeks.Every project is a new cloud, a new stack, a new problem. One year here teaches what three years elsewhere would.You’ll never just take tickets. You’ll own problems, ship fast, and grow with the founders we partner with. Benefits & Perks💰 Competitive salary, 100% salary during probation🏝 Unlimited PTO + public holidays🩺 Premium healthcare insurance + annual health check⚽ Sports clubs for every taste: football, badminton, billiards, pickleball🎮 PS5 and Nintendo at the office🏠 Hybrid working style, flexible hours✈️ Company trip + monthly birthday parties💻 MacBook provided📜 Social insurance per Labor Law Work LocationHCM: 2nd Floor XL Building, 167 Tran Nao, An Khanh WardDa Nang: 2nd Floor, 458 Nguyen Huu Tho, Cam Le Ward

title: Associate DevOps Engineer
description_clean: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life. About The Role MetaDefender Cloud is OPSWAT’s cloud-native SaaS platform. Organizations worldwide use it to detect and prevent file-borne threats through Multiscanning, Deep CDR™, Sandbox and threat intelligence APIs. As an Associate DevOps Engineer, you’ll help keep this platform fast, secure and always available, working alongside senior engineers on the infrastructure that handles large volumes of untrusted files every day. AI is part of how this team builds and operates the platform, and you’ll use it from day one. What You Will Be Doing Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, and Kubernetes manifests with Kustomize and Helm, delivered through GitOps (Argo CD) across multiple AWS regionsOperate and improve CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions so engineering teams can ship scanning and threat-intelligence features safely and oftenSupport development teams in deploying and running containerized microservices on Amazon EKS, including the message queues, caches and databases they depend onMonitor system health, performance and cost; take part in troubleshooting and incident response for production issuesAutomate routine operational tasks such as scaling, patching, backups and new-region setupApply security best practices across cloud infrastructure, as fits a platform built to handle malicious contentWrite and maintain runbooks and technical documentation How We Work With AI AI assistants and internal AI agents are part of our delivery flow: an agent scores the risk of every infrastructure pull request and routes it to the right approvers, and AI review runs on code changesYou will use AI to draft Terraform and Kubernetes changes, investigate alerts and logs, and write runbooks and incident notesYou stay accountable for every change: you review each plan before it is applied, and no agent approves or merges on your behalfYou will help run the AI tooling itself: CI workflows that call AI models, the API keys and access they need, and least-privilege credentials for agents What We Need From You A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experienceHands-on experience with AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC)Familiarity with CI/CD, ideally GitHub ActionsA good understanding of Docker and basic Kubernetes (pods, deployments, services; reading logs and events with kubectl)Scripting skills in Bash and/or Python, plus comfort with YAML/JSON configurationBasic Linux administration and networking knowledge (DNS, load balancing, TLS)Regular use of AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor), with the habit of checking their output before trusting itGood written English for runbooks, incident notes and ticketsA willingness to learn, take ownership and work well within a global team It Would Be Nice If You Had Certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect – Associate, AWS DevOps Engineer, or CKA/CKADExperience with Helm, Kustomize and Argo CD, or Kubernetes autoscaling (Karpenter, KEDA)Experience operating Kafka (Amazon MSK), RabbitMQ, Redis (ElastiCache) or MongoDB/Amazon DocumentDBExperience with observability tools such as Coralogix, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus or GrafanaExperience with cloud cost management (tagging, Savings Plans, rightsizing)An interest in cybersecurity or secure cloud practices (secrets management with SOPS or External Secrets, least privilege, vulnerability scanning)Knowledge of information security standards and certifications such as ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27017Experience setting up or operating AI tooling: AI steps in CI pipelines, MCP servers, agent permissions, or LLM services such as Amazon Bedrock OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws. Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

description_clean: Job Description Mô tả công việcTiếp nhận yêu cầu và đặc tả kỹ thuật từ khách hàng (Input), thực hiện các công việc Design & Verification theo yêu cầu của dự án.Phân tích yêu cầu kỹ thuật và đặc tả của khách hàng.Xây dựng Tài liệu đặc tả chức năng (Functional Specification) bằng tiếng Anh.Xây dựng Tài liệu đặc tả triển khai (Implementation Specification) bằng tiếng Anh.Thiết kế RTL bằng Verilog/SystemVerilog hoặc thực hiện thiết kế bằng công nghệ High-Level Synthesis (HLS) sử dụng SystemC/C/C++.Xây dựng Chiến lược Verification (Verification Strategy) bằng tiếng Anh.Lập bảng các hạng mục Verification bằng tiếng Anh.Xây dựng môi trường Verification và các kịch bản Verification sử dụng: SystemVerilog, SVA, UVM, C.Soạn Tài liệu mô tả môi trường Verification bằng tiếng Anh.Lập Báo cáo kết quả Verification bằng tiếng Anh.Phối hợp với khách hàng và các thành viên dự án trong quá trình Design & Verification.Phân tích, xử lý và báo cáo các vấn đề kỹ thuật phát sinh trong dự án.Yêu cầuKHÔNG QUÁ 30 TUỔI.Có 2-3 năm kinh nghiệm thực tế trong lĩnh vực IC Design, Verification hoặc các lĩnh vực liên quan.Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng Verilog.Có khả năng giao tiếp và đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật bằng tiếng Anh.Có khả năng phân tích yêu cầu, giải quyết vấn đề và chủ động trong công việc.Có khả năng làm việc độc lập và tự quản lý tiến độ công việc.Quan trọng: Ứng viên cần có khả năng thực hiện công việc tương đối độc lập, không cần sự hỗ trợ thường xuyên từ các kỹ sư hiện tại của công ty.Kỹ năng/kinh nghiệm ưu tiên: Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng SystemVerilog; Có kiến thức hoặc kinh nghiệm về High-Level Synthesis (HLS); Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng các công cụ HLS của Synopsys/Cadence; Có kinh nghiệm với SVA, UVM hoặc xây dựng Verification Environment; Có kinh nghiệm viết tài liệu kỹ thuật bằng tiếng Anh.Chế độMức lương: 20.000.000 - 35.000.000 VNĐ/tháng (Gross). title: AI Guardrail Model Lead
description_clean: About VinSmart Future VinSmart Future (VSF) is the leading technology company within the Vingroup Corporation, formed by the merger of the group's entire technology ecosystem, including VinApp, VinIT, VinBigdata, and other tech units. As a core driver of Vingroup's future growth, VSF is at the forefront of technological development, with artificial intelligence (AI) as its foundation. With a talented team of nearly 4,000 local and international technology experts, VSF focuses on creating high-utility technologies that enhance lives and connect data, models, and infrastructure to unlock new possibilities. AI Guardrail Model Lead Work Location: Ha Noi: TechnoPark Tower, Vinhomes Ocean Park, Hanoi Ho Chi Minh City: Vincom Dong Khoi, HCMC Job overview We are looking for an experienced AI Guardrail Model Lead to lead the development of AI safety models that safeguard Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agents across the Vingroup ecosystem. The role combines hands-on model development with technical leadership, covering model architecture, training, evaluation, and inference optimization. You will drive innovation in areas such as content safety, prompt injection detection, privacy protection, and policy-aware AI systems. The Lead is expected to bridge model research and production inference: defining model-service interfaces, streaming behavior and serving requirements together with backend/platform engineers, without owning the broader application or gateway platform. Working closely with platform, security, and product teams, you will ensure guardrail solutions are scalable, reliable, and production-ready. The role owns model behavior and the model-serving contract, and jointly designs inference integration with backend/platform teams. Platform teams own gateway/runtime execution, authorization, transport and production infrastructure; ownership of deterministic guardrail processing is defined per component. This position is ideal for a senior AI leader with deep expertise in LLMs, applied research, and mentoring AI/model engineers and collaborating closely with software/backend engineers. Key Responsibilities: LLM model architecture. Set direction across decoder-only LLMs, discriminative heads and instruction-conditioned decision models. Compare specialized classifiers with shared multi-policy models using explicit quality/compute criteria System-1 and dynamic policy reasoning. Research fast policy deciders, including Jev-style instruction-conditioned approaches. Enable policy bundles supplied at inference time, per-policy verdicts and generalization to unseen or updated instructions without retraining for every tenant Streaming decision modeling. Lead causal and incremental classification; design prefix-level supervision, uncertainty handling, KV/prefix-cache reuse, state management and the balance between detection timeliness and latency Inference systems and model-service architecture. Define how guardrail models are exposed as reliable low-latency services, including streaming and non-streaming inference, batching and cache reuse, state/session handling, model and policy versioning, error/overload behavior, and stable inference contracts. Work closely with backend and platform engineers on integration while keeping gateway/runtime implementation outside the core modeling role Training methods and model improvement. Choose training objectives and recipes: supervised fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, multi-task learning, distillation, selective alignment/preference methods and calibration when technically justified Safety and untrusted content. Guide research for unsafe content, jailbreaks, direct/indirect prompt injection, malicious tool/web input and sensitive-data detection; favor separate specialist components where they outperform a universal model Evaluation and technical leadership. Own dataset quality, held-out policy tests, false-positive/failure analysis and controlled ablations. Review designs and code, mentor AI/model engineers and translate findings into clear model-service contracts Requirements Must-have Approximately 5+ years in ML/NLP/LLMs or compelling equivalent outcomes, including substantial first-hand model training and evaluation. Strong Python/PyTorch and Transformer/causal LM understanding: attention, tokenization, representation heads, training objectives, adaptation, decoding and inference behavior. Practical command of SFT, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, distillation and multi-task learning; ability to assess when more complex alignment or optimization techniques add value. Ability to design instruction/policy-conditioned models, structured per-policy predictions and experiments separating memorization from policy generalization Fluency in recall/FPR at fixed operating points, calibration, label quality, dataset leakage, distribution shift and reproducible ablations. Hands-on GPU profiling, batching and caching trade-offs; ability to reason about stateful streaming inference and production constraints. Production inference understanding. Practical understanding of how ML/LLM models are served in production: synchronous and streaming APIs, batching, backpressure, cancellation, state/session lifecycle, model loading and versioning, observability, failure handling, and GPU-serving trade-offs. Able to design clear contracts and debug integration issues with backend/platform engineers; deep backend specialization is not required. Evidence of mentoring AI/model engineers, code/design review and cross-functional technical decision-making; able to use English research literature. Nice-to-have Experience with low-latency System-1 decision models or Jev-style policy deciders, policy-as-instruction training, or streaming guardrail architectures. Work in model safety, prompt injection, privacy/PII, adversarial or multilingual data; Vietnamese NLP experience. Hands-on experience with production inference stacks such as vLLM, Triton, SGLang or equivalent; distributed/model-parallel serving, continuous batching, prefix caching, quantization or custom serving extensions. Research publications, open-source training contributions or strong reproducible modeling artifacts. Why You’ll Love Working Here: Flexible working hours and attendance policy (Work from Home on working Saturdays). Attractive compensation and bonus packages, highly competitive in the market. Exclusive employee benefits across the Group’s ecosystem in accordance with company policies. Opportunity to work on large-scale and strategic technology projects. Professional technology environment with leading scientists, experts, and engineers from top technology companies in Vietnam and around the world. Free access to learning platforms such as Udemy, Coursera, and O’Reilly; internal workshops; sponsorship for professional certifications; and exclusive mentoring programs from the Group and Company leadership team. Full statutory insurance coverage in accordance with Vietnamese Labor Law (Social Insurance, Health Insurance, Unemployment Insurance), along with private healthcare insurance based on job grade and annual health check-ups at reputable hospitals and healthcare centers nationwide. Participation in internal activities, team-building programs, and annual company events.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (On-Device AI Prototyping)
description_clean: Company: Qualcomm Vietnam Company Limited, Hanoi Branch Office Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering General Summary: Qualcomm AI Research is seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building AI-powered applications. We are looking for engineers who can rapidly transform cutting-edge AI research into working prototypes, with particular interest in agentic AI systems that combine foundation models, tools, memory, planning, and reasoning capabilities. You will work closely with AI researchers to develop and validate next-generation agentic experiences, turning emerging research concepts into real-world prototypes running across mobile, edge, cloud, and Snapdragon-powered platforms. In this hands-on role, you will design and implement applications, frameworks, and system components that showcase Qualcomm's AI capabilities. The position focuses on rapid prototyping, agentic AI workflows, software architecture, experimentation, and system integration, helping bridge research and product through robust demos and internal tools. What You’ll Do Develop prototype applications and system components that showcase advanced AI capabilities. Collaborate with AI researchers to transform emerging AI technologies into compelling end-to-end experiences. Rapidly prototype and evaluate new agent architectures, workflows, and user experiences. Build proof-of-concept systems that integrate AI agents with mobile, edge, cloud, and device capabilities. Architect clean, maintainable, and extensible software systems that support rapid experimentation and iteration. Contribute to internal frameworks, tools, and infrastructure that accelerate AI prototyping. Key Responsibilities Agentic AI Application Development: Design and implement software components, frameworks, and end-to-end prototypes. Develop agent-enabled applications that combine foundation models, tools, APIs, external services, and device capabilities. Evaluate emerging agent architectures, workflows, and user experiences. AI Integration & System Development: Work with AI researchers and system engineers to integrate and evaluate AI models and agentic workflows, including tool integration, orchestration logic, memory systems, runtime integration, and end-to-end data flows. Provide practical feedback on feasibility, performance bottlenecks, system constraints, and user experience. Software Engineering Excellence: Drive high-quality software design, architecture, testing, and maintainability. Build internal tools and automation to improve engineering productivity and prototyping velocity. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with researchers and engineers to deliver impactful prototypes. Communicate technical designs, trade-offs, and implementation details effectively. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of software development experience OR Master’s degree and 3+ years OR PhD and 2+ years OR equivalent industry experience in systems or mobile development. Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Java, Kotlin, Go, or Rust. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including architecture design, modularity, testing, debugging, and performance optimization. Experience designing and building complex software systems with clean, maintainable code. Experience developing applications or systems from concept to working prototype. Excellent problem-solving and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience building agentic AI applications using LLMs, multimodal models, tool calling, workflow orchestration, memory systems, planning, reasoning, or multi-agent architectures. Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, MCP, or similar technologies. Experience evaluating and improving agent reliability, task completion, and user experience. Experience rapidly prototyping AI-powered applications and bringing research concepts to working demonstrations. Experience integrating AI-powered features across mobile, edge, cloud, or embedded platforms. Familiarity with Snapdragon platforms or on-device AI deployment is a plus. Experience building internal tools, automation systems, or developer productivity solutions. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. OR PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Applicants: Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. description_clean: Về chúng tôi Majorbird là Đối tác Bạc của Odoo (từ năm 2020), được sáng lập bởi một đội ngũ Trung – Pháp và đặt trụ sở chính tại Nam Sơn, Thâm Quyến. Chúng tôi là một đội ngũ quốc tế gồm 17 người, có văn phòng tại Hồng Kông, Trung Quốc, Việt Nam và Mexico. Chúng tôi đã triển khai hơn 100 dự án ERP và chuyên về những dự án đa công ty, đa tiền tệ và xuyên biên giới phức tạp mà phần lớn đối tác né tránh — trải dài khắp Châu Á – Thái Bình Dương, Trung Đông và Mỹ Latinh. Chúng tôi thiên về kỹ thuật, tư duy sản phẩm và luôn đi đầu: tham gia sâu vào các công nghệ tiên tiến và thực sự hiểu cách doanh nghiệp vận hành. Chúng tôi hay nói rằng ERP là trường kinh doanh tốt nhất của thời hiện đại — ở đây bạn thấy các công ty thật vận hành ra sao (tài chính, chuỗi cung ứng, sản xuất, bán hàng) và học cách làm cho chúng tốt hơn. Vị trí — Lập trình viên ERP (Odoo) — Việt Nam Bạn xây dựng và tùy biến Odoo trên các dự án khách hàng thực tế với mức độ tự chủ ngày càng cao — phát triển module, tích hợp và báo cáo, đồng thời làm chủ tính năng từ đầu đến cuối. Công việc của bạn Phát triển và tùy biến các module, tích hợp và báo cáo trên Odoo.Làm chủ tính năng từ đầu đến cuối — từ phân tích cùng tư vấn viên đến bàn giao.Viết code sạch, có kiểm thử và tuân thủ quy chuẩn kỹ thuật của chúng tôi.Sửa lỗi, cải thiện các tính năng hiện có và góp phần giữ chất lượng cao. Yêu cầu bắt buộc 1–3 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển phần mềm với Python và kinh nghiệm thực tế với Odoo.Có khả năng hoàn thành tính năng với mức giám sát hạn chế.Tò mò về logic nghiệp vụ phía sau dòng code.Tiếng Anh viết là bắt buộc.Vị trí này không yêu cầu tiếng Anh giao tiếp. Điểm cộng PostgreSQL, JavaScript / OWL, Git, Linux hoặc Docker.Bằng Khoa học máy tính / Kỹ thuật hoặc các dự án cá nhân nổi bật.Đã từng tham gia các dự án Odoo đa công ty / đa tiền tệ. Mức lương Mức lương: 15.000.000–25.000.000 VND/tháng, tùy theo kinh nghiệm. Điều tuyệt vời ở vị trí này Nhìn dự án từ đầu đến cuối và làm chủ tác động thật — không phải một mảnh nhỏ trong cỗ máy khổng lồ.Làm việc trên các hệ thống đa công ty / đa tiền tệ thực sự phức tạp, không phải những cấu hình rập khuôn.Phát triển nhanh nhờ được dẫn dắt bởi người giàu kinh nghiệm, với lộ trình rõ ràng.Gia nhập một đội ngũ quốc tế thiên về kỹ thuật, công bằng và gắn bó dài hạn. Quyền lợi Thưởng dự án — trích theo quý dựa trên dòng tiền thu về của các dự án bạn tham gia triển khai.Tài trợ chứng chỉ Odoo — hoàn trả toàn bộ lệ phí thi — cùng đào tạo thường xuyên.Phép năm: 5 ngày sau năm làm việc đầu tiên, +1 ngày mỗi năm, tối đa 15 ngày.Thêm 1 ngày nghỉ có lương dịp Giáng sinh (nét văn hóa của đội ngũ Trung – Pháp).Bảo hiểm xã hội theo luật (BHXH / BHYT / BHTN) và các phúc lợi địa phương.Hoạt động team-building hằng quý, hộp quà ngày lễ và quà sinh nhật.Trang thiết bị làm việc do công ty cung cấp.Làm việc tại văn phòng ở TP. Hồ Chí Minh, với 1 ngày làm việc từ xa mỗi tuần. Cách chúng tôi làm việc Chúng tôi tôn trọng con người của mình, vì vậy họ tôn trọng công ty. Chúng tôi công bằng và xây dựng cho dài hạn.Chúng tôi không phải một "body shop" — mà là một đối tác tư duy sản phẩm, xem Odoo như một hệ thống sống, minh bạch tuyệt đối và không có toan tính ẩn giấu.Bạn gia nhập một đội ngũ nhỏ, giàu kinh nghiệm, quốc tế — nơi công việc của bạn được nhìn thấy và sự phát triển của bạn là thật. Cách ứng tuyển Nhấn Apply Now (Ứng tuyển ngay) trên trang này và giới thiệu đôi nét về bản thân. Chúng tôi xem xét mọi hồ sơ và sẽ phản hồi bạn.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description_clean: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life. The Position OPSWAT is committed to harnessing the power of AI to drive meaningful advancements across all areas of our business. We are currently seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Engineer to lead the deployment and optimization of Large Language Models for efficient, high performance inference on GPU hardware. In this role, you will own the infrastructure layer that turns our AI models into fast, cost effective, production grade services. You will work closely with the AI/ML Team, the Enterprise & Data Team, and Infrastructure to design local LLM serving environments, maximize GPU utilization, and apply model compression techniques such as quantization from FP32 down to FP8/FP4. This is a chance to work at the deep intersection of models, serving software, and hardware within a global cybersecurity company, delivering the performance that powers OPSWAT's AI products at scale. What You Will Do Local LLM Deployment & Hardware Setup: Design and build local LLM serving environments on GPU hardware, selecting GPU configurations based on VRAM, memory bandwidth, and workload. Install and maintain the full inference stack (NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, cuDNN, inference engines) across single and multi GPU deployments, including tensor and pipeline parallelism.Inference Optimization & Model Compression: Optimize LLM models for efficient GPU serving, balancing latency, throughput, memory, and cost. Apply quantization from FP32 to FP16/BF16, FP8, and FP4 using PTQ methods (GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant) and QAT. Design mixed precision strategies and run calibration to minimize quality loss. Apply complementary techniques including pruning, distillation, and sparsity.Serving Engine & Performance Engineering: Deploy and tune high throughput serving engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI), optimizing KV cache (PagedAttention), continuous batching, and speculative decoding. Leverage optimized kernels (FlashAttention) and FP8 tensor cores. Build benchmarking for TTFT, inter token latency, throughput, GPU utilization, and cost per million tokens.Production Serving Infrastructure: Deploy quantized models with autoscaling, load balancing, and observability. Establish quality regression gates and run A/B tests of quantized vs full precision models on real traffic.Research & Propose Innovative Solutions: exploring and implementing novel inference optimization and model compression techniques. What We Need From You Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.5+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on ML infrastructure, LLM inference, or model optimization.Hands on experience deploying and serving LLMs on GPU hardware in production.Strong understanding of quantization and model compression (FP8/FP4/INT8/INT4, GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, QAT).Experience with high throughput inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, llama.cpp).Solid understanding of GPU architecture, CUDA, and the memory bandwidth bound nature of LLM inference.Familiarity with KV cache, continuous batching, PagedAttention, and speculative decoding.Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, etc.).Good communication, collaboration, and problem solving skills.Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast paced environment.Proficiency in Python; familiarity with C++/CUDA is a strong plus. It Would Be Nice if You Have Experience writing or tuning custom CUDA / Triton kernels.Experience with multi GPU and distributed inference.Certifications in AWS or Azure architecture.Experience with CI/CD and cloud production deployment (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including GPU backed instances. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

description_clean: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam Apply Now! Về chúng tôi Majorbird là Đối tác Bạc của Odoo (từ năm 2020), được sáng lập bởi một đội ngũ Trung – Pháp và đặt trụ sở chính tại Nam Sơn, Thâm Quyến. Chúng tôi là một đội ngũ quốc tế gồm 17 người, có văn phòng tại Hồng Kông, Trung Quốc, Việt Nam và Mexico. Chúng tôi đã triển khai hơn 100 dự án ERP và chuyên về những dự án đa công ty, đa tiền tệ và xuyên biên giới phức tạp mà phần lớn đối tác né tránh — trải dài khắp Châu Á – Thái Bình Dương, Trung Đông và Mỹ Latinh. Chúng tôi thiên về kỹ thuật, tư duy sản phẩm và luôn đi đầu: tham gia sâu vào các công nghệ tiên tiến và thực sự hiểu cách doanh nghiệp vận hành. Chúng tôi hay nói rằng ERP là trường kinh doanh tốt nhất của thời hiện đại — ở đây bạn thấy các công ty thật vận hành ra sao (tài chính, chuỗi cung ứng, sản xuất, bán hàng) và học cách làm cho chúng tốt hơn. Vị trí — Lập trình viên ERP (Odoo) — Việt Nam Bạn xây dựng và tùy biến Odoo trên các dự án khách hàng thực tế với mức độ tự chủ ngày càng cao — phát triển module, tích hợp và báo cáo, đồng thời làm chủ tính năng từ đầu đến cuối. Công việc của bạn Phát triển và tùy biến các module, tích hợp và báo cáo trên Odoo.Làm chủ tính năng từ đầu đến cuối — từ phân tích cùng tư vấn viên đến bàn giao.Viết code sạch, có kiểm thử và tuân thủ quy chuẩn kỹ thuật của chúng tôi.Sửa lỗi, cải thiện các tính năng hiện có và góp phần giữ chất lượng cao. Yêu cầu bắt buộc 1–3 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển phần mềm với Python và kinh nghiệm thực tế với Odoo.Có khả năng hoàn thành tính năng với mức giám sát hạn chế.Tò mò về logic nghiệp vụ phía sau dòng code.Tiếng Anh viết là bắt buộc.Vị trí này không yêu cầu tiếng Anh giao tiếp. Điểm cộng PostgreSQL, JavaScript / OWL, Git, Linux hoặc Docker.Bằng Khoa học máy tính / Kỹ thuật hoặc các dự án cá nhân nổi bật.Đã từng tham gia các dự án Odoo đa công ty / đa tiền tệ. Mức lương Mức lương: 15.000.000–25.000.000 VND/tháng, tùy theo kinh nghiệm. Điều tuyệt vời ở vị trí này Nhìn dự án từ đầu đến cuối và làm chủ tác động thật — không phải một mảnh nhỏ trong cỗ máy khổng lồ.Làm việc trên các hệ thống đa công ty / đa tiền tệ thực sự phức tạp, không phải những cấu hình rập khuôn.Phát triển nhanh nhờ được dẫn dắt bởi người giàu kinh nghiệm, với lộ trình rõ ràng.Gia nhập một đội ngũ quốc tế thiên về kỹ thuật, công bằng và gắn bó dài hạn. Quyền lợi Thưởng dự án — trích theo quý dựa trên dòng tiền thu về của các dự án bạn tham gia triển khai.Tài trợ chứng chỉ Odoo — hoàn trả toàn bộ lệ phí thi — cùng đào tạo thường xuyên.Phép năm: 5 ngày sau năm làm việc đầu tiên, +1 ngày mỗi năm, tối đa 15 ngày.Thêm 1 ngày nghỉ có lương dịp Giáng sinh (nét văn hóa của đội ngũ Trung – Pháp).Bảo hiểm xã hội theo luật (BHXH / BHYT / BHTN) và các phúc lợi địa phương.Hoạt động team-building hằng quý, hộp quà ngày lễ và quà sinh nhật.Trang thiết bị làm việc do công ty cung cấp.Làm việc tại văn phòng ở TP. Hồ Chí Minh, với 1 ngày làm việc từ xa mỗi tuần. Cách chúng tôi làm việc Chúng tôi tôn trọng con người của mình, vì vậy họ tôn trọng công ty. Chúng tôi công bằng và xây dựng cho dài hạn.Chúng tôi không phải một "body shop" — mà là một đối tác tư duy sản phẩm, xem Odoo như một hệ thống sống, minh bạch tuyệt đối và không có toan tính ẩn giấu.Bạn gia nhập một đội ngũ nhỏ, giàu kinh nghiệm, quốc tế — nơi công việc của bạn được nhìn thấy và sự phát triển của bạn là thật. Cách ứng tuyển Nhấn Apply Now (Ứng tuyển ngay) trên trang này và giới thiệu đôi nét về bản thân. Chúng tôi xem xét mọi hồ sơ và sẽ phản hồi bạn. Apply Now!

Collaborate with Product Management and QA to understand requirements, make technical trade-offs, and deliver reliable product features.
