description_clean: Who We Are With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. What We Need We are looking for a Senior 3D Web Engineer to join our Simulation Team within our Software Engineering organization. Your job will be to design and develop cloud-based 3D digital twin and simulation applications that enable users to visualize, analyze, test, and interact with robotic warehouse automation systems. You will help build next-generation simulation platforms by combining modern frontend development, real-time 3D visualization, and digital twin technologies. What We Do The Simulation Team is part of the Software Engineering organization, which is responsible for building the software platforms and technologies that power Symbotic's warehouse automation solutions. Our team develops simulation systems, digital twin platforms, cloud applications, and visualization tools that help engineers, operators, and stakeholders better understand, validate, and optimize robotic automation workflows. What You’ll Do Design, develop, and maintain cloud-based 3D digital twin and simulation applications for robotic warehouse automation systems. Build interactive 3D web applications using technologies such as Three.js, WebGL, WebGPU, and related modern frontend technologies. Develop frontend features that enable users to visualize robot movement, warehouse layouts, fleet behavior, simulation results, telemetry data, and system-level automation workflows. Work on 3D rendering, scene management, camera controls, object interaction, animation, lighting, shadows, shaders, materials, and performance optimization. Identify and resolve frontend and 3D rendering performance bottlenecks to ensure smooth user experience across different platforms, browsers, and hardware configurations. Integrate 3D visualization features with backend services, simulation engines, cloud APIs, telemetry streams, and digital twin data sources. Collaborate with simulation engineers, robotics engineers, cloud engineers, backend engineers, UX/UI designers, product managers, and QA engineers to deliver cohesive and scalable simulation platform experiences. Translate complex robotics, simulation, and operational requirements into intuitive and effective user-facing tools. Provide senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders with clear technical insights, trade-off analysis, risks, and recommendations to support long-term technical roadmaps. Mentor other engineers, share technical knowledge, promote frontend and 3D engineering best practices, and help the team deliver innovative and scalable solutions. Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, frontend design notes, API integration guides, and usage instructions. Stay up to date with modern frontend development, 3D web graphics, cloud-based simulation, digital twin platforms, rendering engines, and AI-assisted development tools. Perform other related duties as reasonably assigned by the direct manager or the Employer. What You’ll Need Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Game Development, Computer Graphics, Robotics, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience in frontend development and/or 3D application development. 3+ years of professional experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Vue.js, Angular, or similar technologies. Plus{{:}} Experience with Blender Plus{{:}} Experience with robotics systems, warehouse automation, digital twin platforms, simulation systems, telemetry visualization, or operational data platforms. Plus{{:}} Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar tools. Good teamwork, communication, time management, ownership, and problem-solving skills. Working proficiency in verbal and written English, with the ability to communicate independently in an international environment and clearly present technical concepts, findings, risks, and recommendations to leadership stakeholders. description_clean: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview Our R&D Center in Vietnam is a strategic AI Hub. We are building a unified, high-performance software foundation that powers Intelligent Edge Devices—from smart cameras to dedicated AI box processors—bringing server-class intelligence to the edge. Job Description Role Vision We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as a core Individual Contributor within our AI Engineering organization. In this high-impact role, you will take ownership of researching, designing, and developing cutting-edge Computer Vision algorithms to solve real-world public safety challenges. Recognizing that modern AI encompasses vast and diverse domains, we offer high flexibility in this role. We do not expect candidates to be full-stack masters of every domain. Instead, we highly value deep specialization. We welcome candidates who possess profound, hands-on expertise in EITHER resource-constrained Edge inference optimization OR large-scale Cloud AI model development and algorithmic data mining. Core Responsibilities As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will contribute heavily to core algorithm development while leveraging your specific strengths: Core AI/ML Development Design, train, and fine-tune high-performance deep learning models for complex vehicle attribute detection and optical character recognition (OCR) utilizing modern architectures (CNNs, Vision Transformers).Apply a Data-Centric AI approach, potentially leveraging Generative AI (Diffusion Models, GANs) for Synthetic Data Generation to overcome long-tail anomalies and obscured data in natural environments.Write clean, highly efficient, well-documented, and maintainable production-level code (Python/C++). Specialized Domain Focus (Depending On Your Primary Expertise) If specializing in Edge AI: Rigorously profile trained models to identify latency bottlenecks. Apply advanced optimization techniques (INT8/FP16 quantization, pruning) and convert models for deployment via TensorRT, TFLite, or ONNX on embedded hardware (ARM CPUs, custom NPUs, low-power devices).If specializing in Cloud AI & Data Mining: Architect and develop advanced machine learning algorithms and AI pipelines to mine actionable insights from massive cloud-based datasets. Focus on large-scale model training, integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for complex text-to-image retrieval, and optimizing deep learning architectures to process and extract intelligence from high volumes of unstructured video/image data. Basic Requirements Experience & Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, or a related technical field.7+ years of rigorous professional experience in applied Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or AI Research/Development.Proven hands-on track record of transitioning models from research/prototypes into robust commercial production. Technical Competencies Deep practical mastery of AI frameworks, primarily PyTorch or TensorFlow.Strong programming proficiency in modern Python and/or C++ within Linux environments.Specialization Flexibility: Demonstrated deep expertise and practical achievement in AT LEAST ONE of the following domains:Domain A (Edge AI): Hardware acceleration, edge model profiling, model compression, and deployment tools (TensorRT, TFLite, edge devices).Domain B (Cloud AI & Data Mining): Deep expertise in large-scale AI model training, computer vision algorithms, and designing complex AI pipelines for handling massive datasets (e.g., extracting statistical patterns and intelligence from billions of records). Preferred Familiarity with Multimodal Foundation Models (e.g., CLIP, LLaVA) for Open-Set Recognition or Text-to-Image retrieval.Experience in building Agentic workflows or automated Active Learning systems. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description_clean: The Job in short The Data Enablement team is here to enable every team in the organisation with their data needs. Our job starts the moment that data enters our platform and ends when it reaches whoever needs it. We are a small, senior team of data and AI engineers, working across customer data, product knowledge, and the data the organisation runs on. We bring data in, reconcile it into one version people can rely on, and make it available to the right audience. Increasingly that audience is agents as well as people, so everything we build has to work for both. Two things must hold at every step: that only the right people can see it, and that we can prove it is correct. You build the platform that makes both possible. As a Senior Data Engineer you own the foundation: the lakehouse, the pipelines that fill it, and the layers that serve it. We treat data as a product, so each one has a named owner, a documented contract with the teams who consume it, and stated expectations on freshness and quality. That includes Data as a Service, where internal and external teams run analytics on data held in our AI-powered Banking OS. This is not only a tabular data job. A large part of it is a versioned documentation corpus, kept current, deduplicated and traceable across many product versions, and much of it arrives semi-structured rather than clean. The consumers are not only dashboards either. You build and maintain the MCP tools that let AI agents query documentation, API specs and release history directly. That is a meaningful part of the role, not a side project. We hold pipelines to the same standard as application code: tested, reviewed, deployed through CI/CD, observable in production, and promoted properly across environments. If that is already how you think about data engineering, you will recognise this team quickly. Meet the job Develop and maintain pipelines extracting data from many sources: RDBMS, Change Data Capture and streaming endpoints.Process data ranging from observability metrics to bank accounts and transactions, in a highly secure and compliant manner.Transform raw data into business-ready analytical models on a Data Lakehouse.Guard data consistency, quality and end to end governance across the full lifecycle.Unstructured data at scale. Ingest and maintain a large versioned documentation corpus: incremental sync, change tracking, deduplication and freshness. Much of it is public or semi-structured source material rather than clean tabular data.Agent-facing data tools. Build and maintain MCP tools that let AI agents query documentation, API specs and release history. A meaningful part of this role.Pipelines as software. GitHub Actions CI/CD, automated tests, observability and proper environment promotion across Fabric and Databricks. We automate through GitHub, and we expect the same engineering discipline from data pipelines as from application code. How About You A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related field.5+ years of experience in data engineering, preferably Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks or Spark. Strong experience on another major cloud is fine if you are ready to convert.Expertise in Data Lakehouse concepts and Delta Lake.Working knowledge of data regulation and compliance, and the judgement to know when to involve Legal.Strong technical leadership. You can drive a piece of work end to end, take the calls with other value streams and stakeholders yourself, and keep it moving without a project manager.Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.Proactive, autonomous and self-sufficient. You work independently on your own projects and take the calls with other value streams and stakeholders yourself.Python and SQL depth, including pipeline and query performance work. Strong pluses Experience with data contracts and making a platform other teams can self-serve from.A BI layer in production, such as Power BI.Machine learning fundamentals, enough to work with AI engineers as a peer.Retrieval and vector search. Building or maintaining the vector and hybrid search layer that AI products query.Preparing data for model training or fine-tuning, including anonymisation of sensitive data.Instrumenting retrieval so its quality can be measured by someone else. Our tech stack Languages: Python, SQL.Platform: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Blob, Cosmos DB, Azure Key Vault.Processing and orchestration: PySpark, Fabric pipelines and notebooks.Ops: GitHub Actions, Fabric deployment pipelines, Power BI.AI surface: MCP, vector and hybrid search.

title: Lead Engineer (Production Bioinformatics & ML Platform)
description_clean: The RoleWe are looking for a Lead Engineer to lead, technically, the team that builds and runs our commercial software platform: the production system that runs our R&D team's bioinformatic pipelines (mostly Nextflow) and machine-learning models at high volume, every day, for the clinical genetic tests our customers rely on. Your team makes these pipelines reliable, scalable, traceable and fast in production, and keeps them that way as the load grows.The platform sits between R&D and IT. You will not manage either team, yet much of your work depends on both, so the role needs strong architectural judgement and the people skills to move work forward through influence rather than authority.This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set the platform's technical direction and make its key technical decisions — designing it to absorb growing volumes, new tests and new models without being rebuilt — while doing a real share of the technical work yourself.What You Will DoSet the technical direction — define where the platform should be in two to three years and the roadmap to get there; make the architecture, technology and build-versus-buy decisions.Stay hands-on — write production code, prototype and benchmark design options, review infrastructure and pipeline code, and lead the investigation of the hardest production incidents.Design for heavy and growing load — workflow orchestration and scheduling, compute capacity, storage and movement of large sequencing files, and predictable turnaround times.Bring pipelines and models into production — packaging, containerisation, versioning, validation, release and rollback, so that new and updated tests ship quickly and safely.Keep the system running smoothly — monitoring, alerting, incident response and capacity planning; set and meet service levels for availability and turnaround time.Build in clinical-grade quality — every result reproducible and traceable to the exact pipeline, model, reference data and software version that produced it; patient data protected; audit and regulatory requirements supported.Lead the team technically — make and explain the key decisions, break the roadmap into deliverable work, guide engineers through design and code review, and set engineering standards, including that AI-generated code is reviewed and owned like any other.Work across R&D and IT — agree with R&D what a production-ready pipeline looks like; plan infrastructure, storage and security with IT; resolve competing priorities through clear proposals and data; and explain technical risks and trade-offs to management.Integrate with international partners — work with partner teams around the world to integrate our solutions with their platforms: agree interfaces and data exchange, deploy into partner environments, and troubleshoot jointly across organizations.What We're Looking ForSubstantial experience building and running production software systems — typically eight or more years — including several years as the technical lead of a team while staying hands-on.A proven track record as an architect of systems that handle heavy and growing load in production.Excellent people skills — delivering through teams you do not manage: negotiating priorities, resolving disagreements and building trust.Clear communication in fluent English, in writing and in person, with executives, scientists, engineers and international partners alike.Strategic thinking and sound judgement — seeing where the system must go and getting there in safe steps, in a setting where results inform patient care.A degree in computer science, software engineering, bioinformatics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.Core Technical SkillsHands-on experience with workflow orchestration and with Slurm and/or cloud infrastructure is required. Across the other areas we expect solid ability in most and real depth in several:Workflow orchestration — how orchestration works (task graphs, scheduling, resource requests, data staging, retries, caching) and hands-on use of at least one framework: Nextflow, Snakemake, WDL/Cromwell, Airflow, Argo or Temporal. Our pipelines are written in Nextflow; if it is new to you, be ready to learn it.Compute infrastructure — Slurm (or another HPC scheduler) and/or AWS, GCP or Azure, including running large batch workloads.Programming — Go, which parts of our platform are written in, and, Python, plus Bash and SQL. Strong engineers from another back-end language are welcome if ready to pick up Go quickly.Software architecture — distributed systems, APIs, queue- and event-driven processing, fault tolerance and horizontal scaling.Containers and Linux — Docker, Kubernetes, Linux administration, networking, storage (including object storage such as S3 or MinIO) and performance profiling.DevOps and reliability — Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and logging.Data and ML in production — relational databases and message brokers (e.g. PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Kafka); packaging, versioning and batch inference of models.Security — access control, secrets management, encryption and secure handling of patient data.Nice to HaveHands-on Nextflow — running pipelines in production, ideally writing and optimising them (DSL2, nf-core).Bioinformatics or NGS data — FASTQ/BAM/VCF and tools such as BWA, samtools or GATK.Both HPC and cloud, hybrid on-premise and cloud architectures, moving very large files over constrained networks, and infrastructure cost control.What We OfferReal ownership of the technical direction of a production system at the heart of the business.Meaningful work: the systems you build deliver results that improve patients' healthcare.Close collaboration with a strong, publication-active R&D team in an international company.A competitive compensation package, including private health insurance.Flexible working hours and a partial work-from-home option (upon approval).

description_clean: 📌 This is a Talent Pool posting, not an active vacancy.We are building a pipeline for Data Engineer opportunities that may open in the coming months.Submit your CV now, and you'll be among the first we contact when a matching opportunity becomes available.Thank you for your interest in Spartan. We look forward to connecting with you!--At Spartan, we don’t act like vendors. We embed with startups backed by YC, Pear VC, BlingCap ,a16z, Techstars, and more - partnering with founders and engineers from Stanford, MIT, Yale, Google, Amazon, Uber, and beyond. Together, we help launch MVPs in 30 days and scale systems that power billions of requests.This isn't a batch-and-dashboards seat three layers from the client. You'll be in the founder's Slack. Your pipelines run in production. You'll own the data platform behind real-time operations, analytics, and AI, from ingestion all the way to serving.Data is the core of the job. Backend and infra come with it, because owning the path to production means you deploy your own work and build the services that hand data to the product. You don't need to arrive as an expert in all three. You do need to be willing to learn the other two.70% of our portfolio is LLM-powered, and every one of those features runs on data someone had to make trustworthy first. That's your work. Cursor, Claude, and Codex are default tools here, not experiments. You'll use AI every day, and you'll be expected to use it well. Who Thrives at SpartanNot every environment fits everyone, so here's an honest picture of the teammates we're looking to build with.You'll thrive here if:You do what it takes to move things forward. A schema redesign today, a backfill script and a founder demo tomorrow.You take on the hardest part of a project and see it through to production.You chase a wrong number until you find where it broke. Silent bad data bothers you more than a loud outage.You'd rather own a problem than simply complete a ticket.You adapt quickly, take responsibility, and care about the impact of what you build.Some weeks will stretch you. That's part of building products in a fast-moving startup environment. But you'll never carry it alone. Whether it's a critical client release or a tricky production issue, your teammates have your back.We push each other because we care about how far each of us can go. We win together. We lose together. Nobody gets left behind.One last thing. We're not just filling seats. We're looking for teammates for the challenges ahead. If you read all this and something in you said yes, trust that feeling and apply. We respect people who back themselves. Every Spartan here started with that same yes. What You'll DoDepending on the project and opportunity, your responsibilities may include:Build data ingestion pipelines for operational, telemetry, and business data, including ETL/ELT, incremental loads, Change Data Capture (CDC), and backfills that don't take production systems down.Design and model data based on how it will be consumed, from upstream event schemas to downstream star schemas, dimensional models, and analytical data marts.Build real-time streaming pipelines with windowed aggregations, stream joins, and robust handling of late, duplicate, and out-of-order events.Own data infrastructure end to end, covering ingestion, processing, storage, transformation, and serving.Ensure data quality and reliability through data contracts, schema evolution, lineage, monitoring, and alerts that detect issues before they impact business decisions.Build the data layer behind AI features, including feature pipelines, embeddings, vector stores, RAG source data, and evaluation datasets.Develop data-serving capabilities, including APIs and services that expose metrics, aggregates, and feature data to product teams.Ship with a proven engineering process, including async standups, PRDs/RFCs, code reviews, automation, and an AI-native workflow using Cursor, Claude, and Codex.Collaborate directly with US startup founders and product leaders, contributing technical insights that shape what gets measured, built, and delivered.Work across engineering disciplines when projects require it. Data Engineering remains your core, but you'll also contribute to backend services, infrastructure, and AI integration.Help shape Spartan's engineering culture, building with ownership, speed, and the mindset of a product engineer rather than a traditional contractor. What We're Looking ForWe value strong Data Engineering fundamentals, production experience, and the ability to take ownership of systems beyond individual pipelines.Fluent English: Able to communicate confidently with US startup founders, product leaders, and international engineering teams.3+ years of professional Data Engineering experience, building and operating production data pipelines, including ingestion, ETL/ELT, incremental loads, backfills, and failure recovery.Strong data modeling skills: Experience with normalized schemas for OLTP and dimensional modeling for analytics, including star schemas, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, and understanding when denormalization is appropriate.Strong SQL skills: Able to analyze query execution plans, identify performance bottlenecks, and optimize complex queries.Production orchestration experience: Hands-on experience with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar tools, including scheduling, dependency management, retries, and idempotent reruns.Strong programming skills: Proficiency in Python, Java, Kotlin, or similar languages, with the ability to write tested, maintainable, and reviewable production code.Production streaming experience: Familiarity with Kafka, Pulsar, AWS Kinesis, or similar technologies, including consumer lag, event replays, duplicate events, and delivery guarantees.Cloud and infrastructure experience: Comfortable deploying and debugging data pipelines on AWS, with working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Terraform, and/or Kubernetes.Strong CS fundamentals: Understanding of distributed systems, partitioning, scalability, and the challenges that arise when data grows beyond a single machine.AI-native mindset: Comfortable using AI tools to improve development workflows, critically reviewing generated code, identifying errors, and knowing when not to rely on AI.Builder's mindset: You don't just move data. You build reliable platforms that make data accessible, trustworthy, and useful. Nice to HaveExperience in one or more of the following areas will be a plus:Stream processing: Hands-on production experience with Flink, Spark, or Kafka Streams.Warehouse and lakehouse technologies: Experience with dbt, Iceberg, Delta Lake, or real-time OLAP stores such as ClickHouse or Druid.Durable execution: Experience with Temporal or similar technologies for managing long-running workflows.IoT and telemetry: Experience handling high-volume ingestion, late and out-of-order events, and large device fleets.ML and LLM infrastructure: Experience with feature stores, vector databases, and training or evaluation data pipelines.Data platform development: Experience building an internal data platform from scratch.Domain knowledge: Experience in rideshare, logistics, mobility, transportation, or other data-intensive industries. description_clean: Overview About Our Partner Our partner is Australia’s only dedicated B2B credit reporting agency, and one of the country’s most innovative fintech success stories. We help Australian businesses of all sizes - from sole traders and family-run operators to ASX listed enterprises - reduce risk, get paid faster and trade with confidence. Our platform helps businesses see financial trouble coming early enough to do something about it. By predicting failure before it happens, we empower our customers to protect revenue, safeguard cash flow and grow with confidence. We offer a complete suite of credit reporting and risk management solutions across the entire customer lifecycle - from onboarding and automated credit decisioning through to ongoing monitoring, PPSR registrations, UBO/KYC reporting and automated collections. Trusted by thousands of businesses across every industry and region in Australia, CreditorWatch sits at the centre of the country’s B2B economy, providing the data, insights and technology that keep trade moving. Our Purpose: Empower Australian businesses to trade confidently with their customers. Our Mission: We aim to be number one in our industry by delivering unique data insights and innovative products. Position Overview: The Senior Data Engineer plays a key role in designing and delivering scalable, high-performance data solutions. This role takes ownership of complex technical components like data pipelines, data and machine learning models, mentors junior engineers, and partners closely with stakeholders to ensure data platforms support product and business needs. Responsibilities Some of your responsibilities include and are not limited to: Design, build and operate data products that serve the CreditorWatch/Collect applications, and internal analytics teams Own data solutions end to end - source integration through to the interface apps and analytics consumers Contribute to the data platform on Databricks - Lakeflow pipelines, Unity Catalog governance, Databricks apps with Lakebase backend Build and extend transformation layers in dbt core, with testability and clear ownership Use Claude Code or similar Agentic AI coding tools and Databricks Agent Skills as a core part of the development workflow with accountability for quality Partner with product, analytics and software engineering teams on how data products are consumed by the broader CW stack Mentor DEs via code reviews, pairing and technical guidance Contribute to architectural decisions, platform standards and continuous improvement Qualifications Competencies (essential behaviours required for the role): Strong expertise in SQL and Python, with track record of delivering production-grade data solutions Experience with modern data platforms and tools such as Databricks, dbt and cloud data warehouses Strong understanding of data modelling and storage patterns for analytical and operational use cases Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally AWS Understanding of data security, governance and access control principles Experience serving data into customer-facing applications, not only analytics / reporting layers Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Databricks Agent Skills) as day-to-day workflow Clear written and verbal communication, especially when working across time zones with teams in Australia Good English communication skills (both verbal & written), especially in the global software development environment. description_clean: LOCATION:VISTA Building, 19 Tan Cang St., Ward 25, Binh Thanh Dist., HCM CityOnly accepting candidates based in Vietnam PROJECT OVERVIEW:KM360 is a next-generation Knowledge Management platform family used inside Microsoft CE&S. It covers content authoring (Rubik), automated content curation and monitoring (Sonic), digital-asset self-healing (Chiron) and content ideation (ContentIdea). The platform runs entirely on Azure — App Service, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Storage, Redis, AI Search and Azure OpenAI — and is delivered through Azure DevOps pipelines. Because it serves Microsoft-internal production workloads, it operates under Microsoft's full security and compliance bar. ROLE OVERVIEW:We are hiring a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to own the engineering platform and the security-and-compliance posture of the KM360 product family.This is a DevOps role first: you will run Azure infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, environments, identity and access for the whole engineering team. On top of that, you become the team's point of accountability for Microsoft's security programs — cloud posture hardening, vulnerability remediation, security design and threat model reviews, privacy, and Responsible AI assessments — turning audit findings into engineering work and closing them.We are an AI engineering team, so there is a third dimension: we want this work automated. If you can build agents and automated pipelines that do the repetitive parts for you, you will have real room to run here. run reviewer feedback rounds through to approval and keep due dates from slipping.Run annual assessments — security, privacy, accessibility, business continuity / DR — and keep the service registry, asset inventory and subscription classification accurate.Support Responsible AI reviews for AI features: document AI use cases and changes, coordinate harm testing (harmful content, jailbreak / prompt injection, groundedness), and record risks and mitigations.Enforce supply-chain controls in release pipelines: SBOM generation, approved package feeds, production-branch change management, code signing and antimalware gates.Report compliance status weekly to engineering and program management; forecast due dates, negotiate extensions and escalate blockers early.Ways of workingParticipate in sprint planning; break security and compliance findings into actionable stories and tasks in Azure DevOps.Automate repetitive ops and compliance work with scripts, pipelines and AI / agent tooling. title: Senior Data Engineer (Customer Data Platform) - DC32
description_clean: YOUR NEW ROLE This role is for CODE LEAP's client company - JTL-Software JTL-Software is one of Germany's leading providers of e-commerce and ERP solutions. More than 50,000 retailers rely on JTL every day to run their business. Our global development center in Vietnam is looking for talented people to build the next generation of these products. You'll work in an international team that pairs German software quality and Vietnamese speed to innovate. Tens of thousands of merchants run their business on JTL. Their data, every order, article and stock movement, is spread across thousands of local systems, where it works for no one. We are changing that. The Customer Data Platform brings merchant data into the cloud, securely and with permission, and turns it into answers merchants can act on. It is the foundation beneath our new BI product, our AI agent Juno and every data product JTL will build next. A first version already runs end to end. Now we are taking it from a handful of pilot merchants to a foundation built for thousands. We are a new, small and senior team with a clear mandate, a modern stack (Python, DuckDB, dbt, PostgreSQL, Dagster, Azure, Terraform) and an AI-native way of working: specs and decision records first, coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex doing much of the implementation, humans owning design, review and judgement. You own the data path: from the moment a merchant's delivery arrives, through validation and nightly builds, to versioned business views that products can trust. Nothing lost, nothing counted twice, no half finished state ever visible, for thousands of merchants at once. We are hiring two Data Engineers with complementary profiles, from Mid-Level to Staff, and set the level with you, based on your experience. The team spans Germany and Vietnam: two senior engineering leaders in Germany and three engineers in Ho Chi Minh City. You will work directly with the German leads, with our internal data team and with the product teams that build on the platform. Working language is English; we work asynchronously by default and meet daily in a shared overlap window. YOUR EXCITING TASKS Design and build tenant-isolated transformation layers with dbt and DuckDB, from raw deliveries to clean, versioned business views. Define data contracts for ERP source tables (orders, articles, stock, invoices) and extend them to new sources step by step. Build idempotent, replayable pipelines: deliveries may arrive twice, results never do.Orchestrate nightly runs per merchant with Dagster, with retries, blast-radius limits and alerts that say what happened. Automate data quality and end-to-end checks into every pull request. Model the metrics products ask for, revenue, margin, stock, reorder signals, together with the product teams.Work agent-first: specify, then let Claude Code and Codex implement, orchestrate agents across pipelines and models, triage pipeline issues with them, and own the review. Keep cost per merchant transparent and low. YOUR PROFILE AND YOUR PERSONALITY 6+ years (Senior) building production data pipelines. Excellent SQL and strong Python; you can read a query plan and you test what you ship.Hands-on experience with dbt (or comparable) and analytical engines such as DuckDB, Spark, Snowflake or BigQuery. Experience with an orchestrator such as Dagster or Airflow. A solid grasp of analytical data modelling: incremental loads, idempotency, late and duplicate deliveries. Experience with relational sources (Microsoft SQL Server or similar) and PostgreSQL.Hands-on, daily experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex: you design agent workflows, orchestrate agents on real work and know when not to trust them. Clear written and spoken English and a habit of writing things down. Nice To Have Multi-tenant data platforms, tenant isolation and row-level security. Data contracts and schema evolution. Terraform, Azure or GitHub Actions. Semantic or metrics layers (MetricFlow, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube). Building agent tooling: MCP servers, custom skills, agent evals, automated issue triage or AI-assisted data operations. E-commerce or ERP data. Benefits Await You At Code Leap Competitive salary and beneﬁtsYear-end bonus (13th-month salary)Generous annual leave of up to 18 daysAdditional premium health insuranceEnjoy an endless selection of delicious refreshments, including gourmet coffee, beverages, snacks, and fresh fruits, all complimentaryDynamic, fun, and agile environment, perfect for sharing and creativityOpen-minded, kind & humble colleagues CONTACT Come to talk to us at jobs@codeleap.de About Us With our expert teams spread across two continents, CODE LEAP provides innovative software solutions for venture-backed companies and leading enterprise businesses in Germany. Our teams in Berlin (Germany) and Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam) work hand in hand to develop state-of-the-art solutions of the highest quality. Because collaborating with the right people is the secret to our successful growth. We future-proof organizations - be part of it!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description_clean: About GeoComply We’re GeoComply! We are at the forefront of geolocation, cybersecurity, and anti-fraud innovation, developing and delivering cutting-edge technologies to help ensure regulatory compliance, combat bad online actors, alleviate user friction, and protect businesses from fraud. Achieving significant business and revenue growth over the past three years and dubbed a tech “Unicorn,” GeoComply has been trusted by leading global brands and regulators for over ten years. Our compliance-grade geolocation technology solutions are installed on over 400 million devices and analyze over 12 billion transactions a year. At the heart of it all is the people, united by a deep commitment to problem-solving and revolutionizing how people and businesses use the internet to instill confidence in every online interaction. With teams across five countries, three continents, and a global customer base, we have no plans to slow down. Why do we create this position? Infrastructure and hosting are vital to GeoComply’s success, ensuring uninterrupted, top-tier service for the US gaming industry. Beyond that, we engineer forward-thinking infrastructure to deliver high availability, key to our uptime, making it easy to scale, accelerating innovation, and keeping pace with industry growth and evolving customer demands. We are an engineering organization navigating a critical migration and innovation phase. Our goal is to reduce cloud platform dependency, optimize costs, and ensure high availability and scalability by migrating service workloads from AWS to GCP. At the same time, we’re modernizing our systems, shifting from a monolithic architecture to microservices, and building a resilient, multi-region platform. To sustain this pace, we are growing our DevOps capability in Vietnam. This role adds senior hands-on execution capacity to the team. We are looking for someone who can own significant workstreams end to end, mentor the engineers around them, and partner directly with development squads as we scale. Job Description As a Senior DevOps Engineer based in Vietnam and part of a global DevOps team, you'll design, build, and operate the infrastructure and DevOps tooling that powers GeoComply's systems. You'll own meaningful pieces of our AWS to GCP migration and multi-region platform on GCP, contributing to a unified, scalable core infrastructure that enables product development teams to deliver value quickly and keep pace with our customers' growing and fast-changing demands. This means shifting DevOps from "Serve" to "Enable" through self-service tooling, without loosening security, standards, or guardrails. You'll help ensure the platform runs reliably 24/7 and holds up under peak events like the Super Bowl, consult product teams on cloud-native best practices, work independently on complex problems, and use AI assistance as a standard part of how you build and operate. Key Responsibilities Cloud Infrastructure & FinOps: Support and maintain our AWS and GCP infrastructure for high availability, identify capability gaps within your scope and propose practical improvements, and treat cost as a first-class design constraint through FinOps practices. Multi-Cloud Delivery & Migration: Own and deliver workstreams across AWS and GCP, including our AWS to GCP migration using GCP-managed services (e.g. GKE, Cloud SQL, Spanner, Pub/Sub, BigQuery), while continuing to operate the AWS workloads that remain business-critical, with cost, performance, and interoperability front of mind. Multi-Region Architecture: Implement and operate multi-region infrastructure across AWS and GCP for low-latency traffic management (shadowing, shifting) and disaster recovery, in partnership with development and data teams. Modernization & System Design: Support the transition from monoliths to microservices and align infrastructure with evolving application needs, promoting automation, scalability, and maintainability. Security & Compliance: Embed security best practices across the infrastructure (IAM, least privilege, secrets management, network policies, data protection) and ensure compliance with industry standards and internal governance. Engineering Platform & Operational Excellence: Improve CI/CD, observability (e.g. LGTM stack, GCP Monitoring), SLIs/SLOs, on-call and incident response, and post-mortems that reach systemic root cause; build reusable patterns and self-service tooling that shift DevOps from "Serve" to "Enable." Knowledge Sharing & Mentorship: Mentor teammates through code and architecture reviews, and support development teams via reusable patterns, documentation, and self-service capabilities rather than by fielding their questions directly. AI-Assisted Engineering: Leverage GenAI tools and AI agents to accelerate common development and operational work so your time goes to the highest-impact engineering, reviewing and verifying output against production standards for reliability, security, cost, and maintainability, and coach teammates to do the same. Requirements 5+ years in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or platform engineering, with demonstrated experience taking medium-to-large infrastructure projects. Strong analytical mindset to define complex problems, evaluate technical trade-offs, and independently navigate ambiguity to drive cross-system solutions to completion. Production expertise with containerization especially in Kubernetes environment, including deep familiarity with cluster lifecycle management, scaling strategies, resource optimization, and troubleshooting cluster and workload issues. Proven experience designing modular Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform) and building secure, automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions). Proven track record of architecting and operating production environments on GCP and/or AWS, specifically leveraging managed services (e.g. GKE/EKS, Cloud SQL/RDS, Pub/Sub/SQS). Experience with multi-cloud/multi-region is a plus. Direct ownership of highly available systems, including on-call, incident response, and post-incident improvement. Proven experience with pillars of telemetry (metrics, logs, traces) and modern observability stacks (e.g LGTM stack, Datadog). Practical experience with SRE concepts and managing cardinality, retention, and cost at scale. Familiar and hands-on practice using AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e.g. Claude Code, OpenCode) on real DevOps work (IaC, debugging, incident triage, post-mortems). Communication: Professional working proficiency in English, written and verbal. Must be able to explain technical decisions clearly in English, in writing, in design documents, and in live discussion. Bonus Points Experience operating Service Mesh solutions (e.g. Istio, Linkerd) in complex microservices environments. Proven track record of tracing packet flow and optimizing end-to-end latency across multi-cluster, multi-region network topologies and cloud-managed service boundaries. ML Infrastructure Engineering: Hands-on experience architecting and operating production ML platforms. Why Join GeoComply: ☘ Hybrid working mode & Modern office at a prime location in District 1 ☘ Professional development budget to support your growth ☘ 20 annual leave days, 5 sick leave days ☘ Premium health insurance (Bao Viet or Liberty) ☘ Social, unemployment, and health insurance contributions based on full salary ☘ Competitive salary package, 100% salary during the probation period ☘ Attractive bonuses (13th month, business performance, equity plans) ☘ Annual salary performance review ☘ Free parking ☘ Annual company trip & Year-end party ☘ Quarterly team-building activities ☘ In-office snacks and drinks (snacks, coffee, juice, milk, etc.) ☘ International working environment Apply Now! We focus on hiring people who value inclusion, collaboration, adaptability, courage, and integrity rather than ticking boxes, so if this resonates with you, please apply. All CVs or resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at our company without a valid written agreement in place for this position will be considered the sole property of our company. To be successful in our organization, you need an eager attitude, professionalism, and the confidence to willingly work to prove yourself and your ideas, and earn the trust of the organization. Here’s why we think you’d love working with us. We’re working towards something big We’ve built a reputation as the global market leader for geolocation compliance solutions for over 10 years. We’re trusted by customers from all over the world, and the next few years will be particularly exciting as we continue to scale across new markets. Our values aren’t just a buzzword Our values are the foundation for what we as a company care about most. They signify the commitment we make to each other around how we act and what we stand for. Learning Is At The Heart Of Our Employee Experience At GeoComply, we foster an environment that empowers every employee to gain the knowledge and abilities needed to perform at their very best and help our organization grow. From a professional development budget to local training opportunities, knowledge-sharing sessions and more, we are continually investing in employee career growth and development. We believe in being a force for good We profoundly care about our impact on the world and strive to make meaningful contributions to the communities we work and live in. Our Impact division focuses on philanthropic and social responsibility initiatives, including supporting our local communities, advancing equality, and harnessing our technology to protect vulnerable groups. Learn more, here . We Care About Our Team Our GeoComply team is talented, driven and hard-working, and is known for its positive attitude and energy. At GeoComply, we take care of our employees with the total package. Team members are generously rewarded with competitive salaries, incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program. We value in-person collaboration GeoComply culture thrives on a dynamic mix of in-person energy and independent focus and we champion a hybrid work model that blends the energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. Our 3-day in-office policy fosters teamwork and innovation, while also recognizing the importance of individual work styles and needs. - - - - - - - - - - At GeoComply, we live our value of Act with Integrity. You'll maintain the definitions and the logic that implements them.Own data quality. VinSmart Future đặt mục tiêu xây dựng nền tảng công nghệ hợp nhất của Tập đoàn Vingroup, kết nối từ quản trị vận hành thông minh đến siêu ứng dụng cho khách hàng, mang lại trải nghiệm số liền mạch và vượt trội. Công ty là nơi quy tụ những nhân tài trong lĩnh vực công nghệ thông tin trong nước và quốc tế. VinSmart Future bao gồm các thành phần trọng tâm:· Hạ tầng công nghệ: trung tâm dữ liệu, máy chủ, đường truyền, bảo mật...· Dịch vụ dùng chung cho quản trị sản xuất kinh doanh: AI, dữ liệu, định danh người dùng, quản lý nhân sự, tài chính - kế toán, mua sắm doanh nghiệp...· Ứng dụng đầu cuối: Siêu ứng dụng tích hợp toàn bộ dịch vụ, các ứng dụng chuyên biệt (ví dụ: Xanh SM), ứng dụng nội bộ (ví dụ: ILoveVingroup)...Với bản lĩnh tiên phong và nội lực công nghệ vững mạnh, VinSmart Future cam kết bứt phá để tạo nên những đột phá công nghệ cho Vingroup, đồng thời đóng góp giá trị thiết thực cho xã hội. Đây cũng là bước tiến quan trọng trong việc hiện thực hóa siêu ứng dụng quốc dân, định hình phong cách sống số hiện đại, thông minh và đẳng cấp tại Việt Nam. Tổng quan về vị trí: Vị trí này đóng vai trò then chốt trong việc đảm bảo sự tin cậy của các Core Engine về Computer Vision tại VinSmart Future. Không chỉ dừng lại ở việc kiểm thử mô hình, kỹ sư sẽ chịu trách nhiệm xây dựng hệ thống "Sự thật khách quan" (Ground Truth) từ các ngữ cảnh thực tế phức tạp, đồng thời phát triển các công cụ tự động hóa để đối soát đầu ra của hệ thống với thực tế sử dụng của khách hàng. Mô tả công việc(Danh sách các chức năng/nhiệm vụ công việc thiết yếu, trách nhiệm và kỳ vọng – sử dụng dấu đầu dòng và ưu tiên các trách nhiệm chính lên đầu, và không quá 10 gạch đầu dòng )1. Phân tích ngữ cảnh thực tế: Nghiên cứu và mô phỏng các kịch bản người dùng (User Scenarios) khắc nghiệt: góc lắp đặt camera, điều kiện ánh sáng (ngược sáng, ban đêm), thời tiết (nắng, mưa, sương mù) để thiết kế bộ dữ liệu test toàn diện.2. Xây dựng Ground Truth: Trực tiếp phân tích videos/Images đầu vào để tạo ra tập dữ liệu Ground Truth (GT) chuẩn xác cho từng kịch bản, làm thước đo đánh giá Core Engine.3. Kiểm soát Core Engine Events: Thực hiện kiểm thử End-to-End; đối soát các sự kiện (Events/Metadata) trả ra từ Core Engine với Ground Truth để đảm bảo tính logic và độ chính xác của hệ thống.4. Phát triển AI Agent thu thập dữ liệu: Ứng dụng AI Agent để tự động hóa việc tìm kiếm, cào dữ liệu (data scraping) hình ảnh/video từ internet theo các user case đề ra.5. Tự động hóa kiểm thử (Automation Test): Xây dựng các công cụ, script (Python) để tự động hóa quy trình chạy test, so sánh kết quả và phát hiện các lỗi logic trong luồng dữ liệu của Engine.6. Báo cáo tự động: Thiết lập pipeline tự động xuất báo cáo kết quả kiểm thử và đồng bộ hóa trực tiếp lên Confluence kèm theo các phân tích lỗi chi tiết.7. Quản lý dữ liệu: Tiếp nhận, làm sạch và chuẩn hóa dữ liệu ngày/đêm, nắng/mưa theo đúng thiết kế của đội ngũ phát triển.8. Phối hợp kỹ thuật: Làm việc chặt chẽ với kỹ sư AI và Backend để làm rõ yêu cầu, phản hồi các trường hợp Edge Case và báo cáo tiến độ triển khai. title: SoC Design Implementation Engineer (Up to Principal Level)
description_clean: Company Qualcomm Vietnam Company Limited Job Area Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering General Summary The SoC Design organization is seeking engineers to contribute to the implementation and front-end readiness of complex SoC, subsystem, and IP designs. This role focuses on design constraints, synthesis, timing analysis, power-intent implementation, and implementation collateral required to deliver high-quality netlists to downstream Physical Design, Design Verification, DFT, emulation, and signoff teams. The successful candidate will work closely with RTL Design, SoC Architecture, Design Verification, Physical Design, DFT, CAD/methodology, power-management, and program teams across the global engineering organization. The role requires a strong understanding of the transformation from RTL to synthesized netlist, including constraint development, synthesis optimization, timing and QoR analysis, low-power implementation using UPF, and resolution of design issues across RTL, constraints, libraries, tools, and flow configuration. I. Responsibilities Design Implementation and Front-End Readiness Support implementation of complex SoC, subsystem, and IP designs from RTL through synthesis and handoff to downstream implementation teams.Review RTL hierarchy, design partitioning, clock and reset architecture, interface definitions, and implementation requirements.Prepare and maintain synthesis scripts, design configuration, file lists, libraries, operating conditions, scenarios, and implementation collateral.Coordinate design releases, dependencies, configuration updates, and implementation readiness across RTL, DV, DFT, PD, CAD, and architecture teams.Analyze design quality and identify RTL, constraint, library, or flow issues affecting timing, power, area, reliability, or implementation convergence.Support design reviews, implementation reviews, signoff reviews, and technical documentation activities.Investigate failures across RTL, synthesis, constraints, UPF, libraries, tool setup, and build environments; identify root cause and drive corrective action. Constraint Development and Timing Readiness Develop, review, and maintain timing constraints for block, subsystem, and SoC-level designs.Create and validate clocks, generated clocks, clock relationships, clock uncertainty, input/output delays, loads, drive models, and operating scenarios.Define and review timing exceptions, including false paths, multicycle paths, asynchronous paths, clock groups, and case analysis.Support multi-mode, multi-corner timing analysis and ensure constraints are complete, consistent, and aligned with design intent.Analyze timing reports, path groups, startpoints, endpoints, slack, path exceptions, clock latency, skew, and constraint coverage.Debug unconstrained paths, invalid constraints, conflicting exceptions, missing clocks, generated-clock issues, and constraint-propagation problems.Collaborate with RTL and Physical Design teams to resolve critical paths, high-fanout issues, excessive buffering, logic depth, congestion risks, and timing-convergence challenges.Review constraints for synthesis, formal equivalence, DFT, static timing analysis, and physical implementation consistency.Develop constraint-quality checks and automation to improve constraint completeness, consistency, and reuse across projects. Synthesis and Netlist Generation Run and debug RTL synthesis for blocks, subsystems, and SoC-level designs using industry-standard synthesis flows.Generate and review synthesis netlists, reports, databases, timing views, and implementation handoff collateral.Analyze synthesis results for timing, area, power, high-fanout nets, unmapped logic, inferred structures, unconnected signals, and optimization quality.Tune synthesis options, compile strategies, effort levels, retiming or optimization settings, and flow configuration to improve QoR while preserving design intent.Identify and resolve issues involving black boxes, missing or mismatched libraries, unresolved references, unintended latches, X-propagation, multiple drivers, and synthesis warnings.Support synthesis quality-of-results tracking and compare changes across RTL, constraints, libraries, tool versions, and implementation configurations.Deliver clean, traceable, and reproducible netlists for Physical Design, DFT, formal equivalence, emulation, gate-level simulation, and signoff activities.Partner with RTL designers to recommend RTL changes that improve timing, area, power, synthesis quality, and downstream implementation convergence. Experience With UPF And Low-power Implementation Is a Plus Develop, integrate, review, and maintain UPF-based power intent for blocks, subsystems, and SoC designs.Define and validate power domains, supply networks, supply sets, power states, isolation strategies, level-shifter strategies, retention requirements, and related low-power structures.Ensure UPF intent is consistent with RTL hierarchy, power architecture, voltage domains, clock/reset behavior, and implementation requirements.Run and debug power-intent checks, including missing or conflicting supplies, invalid domain crossings, incorrect isolation placement, level-shifter issues, retention mismatches, and incomplete power-state definitions.Analyze synthesis results involving isolation cells, level shifters, retention cells, always-on logic, power switches, and other low-power implementation elements.Collaborate with architecture, RTL, PD, DFT, verification, and power-management teams to resolve power-intent interpretation and implementation issues.Support low-power equivalence, power-aware simulation, implementation handoff, and signoff readiness.Improve UPF methodology, reusable templates, validation checks, and automation across projects. Quality, Debug, and Cross-Functional Collaboration Drive implementation quality closure across lint, CDC/RDC, connectivity, synthesis, constraints, UPF, formal, and release-readiness checks.Debug tool failures and design-quality issues using logs, reports, databases, waveforms, and automated analysis.Work with CAD and methodology teams to improve flow robustness, runtime, capacity, repeatability, and ease of adoption.Document implementation assumptions, constraints, exceptions, known issues, methodology decisions, and handoff requirements.Mentor engineers and share best practices in synthesis, timing constraints, UPF, debug, automation, and implementation methodology. II. Level Expectations Engineer Execute assigned implementation, constraint, synthesis, and UPF tasks with guidance from senior engineers.Analyze basic timing, synthesis, and power-intent reports and assist with issue triage and closure.Maintain scripts, configuration, reports, and implementation collateral according to established methodology.Collaborate effectively with partner teams and escalate issues with clear technical information. Senior Engineer Independently own implementation activities for blocks or subsystems from setup through synthesis and handoff.Develop and validate timing constraints, synthesis flows, and UPF implementation for assigned design areas.Drive root-cause analysis and closure of timing, QoR, power-intent, and flow issues across multiple teams.Contribute to methodology improvements, automation, technical reviews, and mentoring. Staff /Senior Staff Engineer Lead implementation of major subsystems or complex SoC design areas, including constraints, synthesis, and low-power intent.Define technical plans, implementation strategy, quality criteria, and handoff requirements.Resolve complex cross-functional issues involving RTL, architecture, tools, libraries, timing, power, and physical implementation.Drive reusable methodology, automation, QoR improvement, and technical alignment across projects. Principal Engineer Establish technical direction for SoC design implementation, synthesis, constraints, and UPF methodology across programs.Lead architecture-level decisions that affect timing closure, power intent, implementation convergence, and design quality.Influence cross-functional organizations and resolve the most complex technical risks and escalations.Define scalable flows, standards, automation, and best practices for future SoC programs and mentor senior technical leaders. III. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.3+ years of relevant experience in RTL design, SoC integration, synthesis, ASIC/FPGA development, or front-end implementation.Experience with at least one RTL development or front-end implementation flow from design through synthesis or implementation handoff.Knowledge of Verilog or SystemVerilog and familiarity with RTL design and SoC integration concepts.Experience developing or reviewing timing constraints and analyzing synthesis or static timing reports.Understanding of clocks, resets, interfaces, timing exceptions, design hierarchy, and implementation tradeoffs.Good communication, problem-solving, ownership, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with synthesis tools, static timing analysis tools, equivalence checking, lint, CDC/RDC, or related front-end quality tools.Practical experience with UPF, power domains, isolation, level shifters, retention, power states, or power-aware verification.Experience with multi-mode, multi-corner constraints and timing closure across block, subsystem, or SoC designs.Knowledge of ASIC implementation flows, DFT, physical design handoff, emulation, FPGA prototyping, or gate-level simulation.Proficiency in Tcl, Python, Perl, Shell, or similar scripting languages for flow automation and report analysis.Experience with AXI, AHB, APB, or other standard on-chip interfaces.Experience working in a large, globally distributed semiconductor engineering organization. IV. Technical Skills RTL: Verilog, SystemVerilog, RTL hierarchy, clock/reset structures, interface integration, and synthesis coding practices.Constraints: clocks, generated clocks, I/O delays, exceptions, clock groups, uncertainty, scenarios, and constraint validation.Synthesis: RTL-to-gate compilation, QoR analysis, timing/area/power optimization, netlist generation, and synthesis debug.Low Power: UPF, power domains, supply sets, isolation, level shifters, retention, power states, and power-aware implementation.Quality and Signoff: lint, CDC/RDC, formal connectivity, equivalence, timing analysis, gate-level simulation, and implementation handoff.Automation: Tcl, Python, Perl, Shell, report parsing, flow integration, regression infrastructure, and methodology development. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 8+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 7+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. title: Sr Staff Digital Engineer – Microcontroller (MCU) Systems & Architecture
description_clean: Job Description Position Overview We are seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Staff Engineer to join our General Purpose Microcontroller (MCU) Design and Architecture team. In this senior technical leadership role, you will lead the specification, RTL implementation, physical synthesis, and full-chip verification of next-generation MCU platforms integrating both RISC-V and ARM® Cortex®-M CPU cores. You will drive the full lifecycle of the System Control Sub-system (SYSSS), CPU Sub-system (CPUSS), Peripheral IPs, IOTOP, and ChipTop design and verification, bridging architecture definitions with silicon implementation, advanced debugging, and technology verification. Key Responsibilities SYSSS, CPUSS, Peripheral IP, IOTOP & ChipTop Design & Verification (Full Flow): Specification & Architecture: Translate high-level Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) into comprehensive Target & Detail Specifications for System Control Sub-system (SYSSS), CPU Sub-system (CPUSS), Peripheral IPs, IOTOP, and ChipTop modules. RTL Implementation & Hand-off: Perform RTL coding (Verilog / SystemVerilog) for SYSSS, CPUSS, Peripheral IPs, IOTOP, and ChipTop. Author and deliver clear implementation instructions to MiddleEnd and BackEnd (Physical Design) teams. Design Verification & Debugging: Create test plans and execute Unit-Level Verification (UT) and Chip-Level / Top-Level Verification (CT) using UVM and SystemVerilog environments. Lead root-cause debugging across IP, MCU, and SoC levels. Physical Synthesis & Technology Verification: Run module-level physical synthesis and perform top-level technology checks, including High-Level DRC (HLDRC), Static Timing Analysis checks (STAchk), and Design-for-Testability checks (DFTchk) at SYSSS and ChipTop levels. Architecture & Subsystem Integration: Define and integrate MCU subsystems around RISC-V and ARM Cortex-M architectures. Integrate key peripherals (WDT, INTC, IIC, SPI, ADC, etc.) and handle clock domain crossing (CDC) / asynchronous transfer designs across clock and reset boundaries. Drive interconnect architecture based on AMBA bus protocols (AHB, APB, AXI). Technical Expertise & Domain Knowledge IP / MCU / SoC Debugging: Strong hands-on experience in IP, MCU, and SoC level development with expert-level debugging skills across front-end RTL, simulation, and post-synthesis environments. Processor Cores & Peripherals: Deep understanding of RISC-V and ARM Cortex-M CPU architectures and common MCU peripherals (e.g., Watchdog Timers [WDT], Interrupt Controllers [INTC], I2C/IIC, SPI, ADC). Bus Protocols & Interconnects: Thorough technical knowledge of AMBA protocols (AHB, APB, AXI, etc.). Asynchronous Transfer & CDC: In-depth knowledge of Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) and Asynchronous Transfer Design techniques to prevent metastability in multi-clock MCU systems. HDL & Programming Languages: High proficiency in industry-standard languages: Hardware / Verification: Verilog, SVA, SystemVerilog, UVM Embedded Software / Verification: C, C++ Scripting & Automation: Perl, Python EDA Toolchains: Hands-on experience with industry-standard Cadence and Synopsys EDA tools, including: Simulators & Debuggers: Xcellium, VCS, SimVision, Verdi RTL Lint, CDC & Static Analysis: Spyglass, and related static check tools. Synthesis and netlist check: Design compiler, Formality, STAcheck (PrimeTime), HLDRC, DFTcheck Design & Verification Flow: Full-flow experience from PRD specification writing to RTL coding, UT/CT testbench creation, verification checklist, coverage. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us? title: Product Engineer
description_clean: About PalexyAt Palexy, our vision is to turn every passive CCTV camera into a powerful Business Intelligence system to empower retail stores to stop losing sales and avoid customer churn. Recognized as one of the top 10 Indoor Mapping Analytics Vendors by CB Insights in 2021, we have deployed our world-class solutions to household retailers in the region, including Central Group, Guardian, Aldo, CellphoneS, PNJ, ACFC, Mat Viet, etc. Every month our analytics platform processes more than 1000 TB of camera footage with billions of data points from millions of shopping journeys in thousands of stores. Our technology stack is built from scratch, with our enterprise-grade AI and Computer Vision algorithms at its core. About the roleWe are looking for Product Engineers: engineers who care as much about what we build and why as about how it is built. You will own a customer problem end to end: understand how a retailer runs their stores, decide what is worth building, ship it, and stay with it until it changes how the customer works. This is not a role where you wait for a finished spec. You will talk to customers, question the requirement, and bring the energy to turn a rough idea into something great. We build with AI tools at every step, from research and design to code, tests and review. We expect you to know how to harness them: to direct AI agents to do most of the work, and to keep the judgment for yourself. A Product Engineer who works this way can take on far more than one engineer could before. What you will doOwn features from the customer problem to the shipped product, across front end and back end.Use AI tools as much as possible in every part of the work: understanding the code base, prototyping, writing and reviewing code, testing, and analyzing data.Build the workflows, prompts and tooling that make AI do more of the work, for you and for the rest of the team.Talk to customers and to our customer-facing teams, watch how the product is used, and turn what you learn into product decisions.Work with product managers and designers to shape the solution, not only to implement it.Judge what to build by its effect on the customer's business, and say so when a smaller or different solution would serve them better.Ship quickly, measure the result, and keep improving until the problem is solved.Stay responsible for what you ship. AI writes much of the code, but you own its quality, and you keep the code base maintainable and scalable. About youA solid Computer Science background: data structures, algorithms, databases, and how systems work. This is what lets you judge and correct what AI produces.Fluency with AI tools. You already build with AI coding agents every day. You know how to give them context, break a problem down for them, check their output, and spot when they are wrong. You keep trying new tools and change how you work when a better one appears.Business sense. You want to know how our customers make money and how the product helps them make more. You can explain the value of a feature in the customer's terms.Customer obsession. You enjoy talking to users, you are bothered when the product lets them down, and you do not consider a feature done until customers use it.Energy to build something great. You take ownership, move fast, and care about the details that make a product a pleasure to use.Some experience building web applications, and you are happy to work on both front end and back end.Some experience with relational databases and SQL.Comfortable working in unfamiliar areas and with unclear requirements.Familiarity with Java, Spring Boot and Angular is a plus. How to applySend your resume to minh@palexy.com, and tell us about one or two of the hardest problems you have solved. We prefer problems you solved for end users: who they were, what was hard about it, how you solved it in detail, and what changed for them.
