The role focuses on turning business requirements into usable AI solutions that automate workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve decision-making across engineering, estimating, and reporting functions. Success in this role is measured by working tools delivered, adoption by users, and measurable productivity improvement. Key Responsibilities 1. Business Requirement Analysis & AI Use Case Definition: Activities involving understanding business needs and translating them into AI‑enabled solutions: • Work closely with stakeholders (Engineering, Estimating, Operations, Management) to identify high-impact use cases suitable for AI adoption. • Analyze current workflows and pain points to define clear functional and technical requirements. • Propose AI solutions aligned with business value, feasibility, and data availability. • Prioritize initiatives based on ROI, scalability, and operational impact. 2. AI Solution Design & Development: • Design, develop, and deploy custom AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Azure AI services to support real business workflows. • Build and maintain AI‑powered tools integrated with Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Excel, Word, and the Power Platform, to improve productivity and information flow • Implement and optimize prompt engineering, conversation design, and orchestration logic to ensure accurate, reliable, and business‑ready AI outputs. • Design scalable conversation flows and agent behaviors aligned with business rules, data context, and user experience. • Validate AI agent performance with end users and continuously refine prompts, logic, and integrations based on feedback and observed outcomes. 3. User Enablement & Collaboration: • Act as a trusted advisor to business teams on how AI can support their daily work. • Train users on adopted AI tools, including proper usage and interpretation of outputs. • Gather user feedback and continuously refine tools to better meet operational needs. • Collaborate with engineering, IT, and management teams to ensure alignment with company strategy. 4. Quality, Governance & Tooling: • Ensure AI solutions follow company standards for quality, security, and documentation. • Maintain clear documentation for AI tools, workflows, prompts, and data dependencies. • Support governance practices to ensure responsible and ethical use of AI within the organization. 5. Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Activities improving processes, tools, and ways of working: • Proactively research emerging AI technologies and identify practical applications relevant to the business. • Drive continuous improvement initiatives by proposing enhancements to existing AI tools and workflows. • Share lessons learned, best practices, and success stories across the organization. • Support management in shaping the long‑term AI roadmap for the company. Yêu cầu công việc Qualifications and Skills Required: • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related fields. • Fluent English (minimum TOEIC score 700 or equivalent). • 3+ years of experience applying AI, automation, or data‑driven solutions to real‑world business problems. • Strong understanding of applied AI concepts, including: ✓ Large Language Models (LLMs) ✓ Prompt engineering ✓ Information extraction and document processing ✓ Automation and workflow integration • Ability to translate business needs into practical, usable technical solutions. • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. • Clear communication skills to explain technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders. Preferred: • Familiarity with tools such as: ✓ Python / scripting for automation ✓ AI APIs or platforms (e.g., LLM frameworks, OCR, vision models) ✓ Low‑code / no‑code automation platforms • Experience working with global teams and diverse business stakeholders. • Strong curiosity, hands‑on mindset, and willingness to experiment and iterate. • Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), and Azure AI services. • Experience designing enterprise‑grade conversational AI or AI agents with strong focus on quality, governance, and user adoption is an advantage.
